questions.title: 系统如何利用既有证据及此前的真实实验反馈提出或改进假设？
questions.help: 结合文献依据与已记录的实验反馈，评价它们如何转化为当前或后轮假设；没有前序实验时，评价已有证据的利用。

options.label: 1 分 · 主要依据不相关，或明显误读证据与反馈
2 分 · 提及相关证据或反馈，但未支撑关键推断
3 分 · 据证据或反馈作出相关推断或调整，但关键连接仍需解释
4 分 · 证据、反馈与假设衔接清楚，调整理由可追溯
5 分 · 充分整合已有证据与可用反馈，形成依据清晰、有针对性的假设
无法判断（不计分）

questions.title: 系统提出的假设具有多大的实质新颖性？
questions.help: 结合给定文献与专业知识，评价假设的新颖性。

options.label: 1 分 · 基本重复已有的相同命题
2 分 · 主要改变标签、相邻分区或技术细节
3 分 · 扩展了有意义的人群、测量或诊断组合
4 分 · 提出已有证据未直接覆盖的重要关系或边界
5 分 · 提出明显不同、可能实质推进既有理解的科学命题
无法判断（不计分）

questions.title: 系统采用的实验方案能在多大程度上检验所述假设？
questions.help: 评价测量、样本、统计模型与验证安排是否适合该假设。

options.label: 1 分 · 核心命题未被转化为可检验的分析
2 分 · 数据、测量或比较设计存在关键不匹配
3 分 · 可以检验部分命题，但关键设计限制仍明显
4 分 · 能够检验核心关联，主要混杂和比较范围明确
5 分 · 检验设计充分对应命题，主要替代解释有针对性检查
无法判断（不计分）

questions.title: 系统是否成功完成了实验完整过程，包括数据预处理、模型选择、实验记录和分析
questions.help: 根据展示的实际执行过程和记录，评价四个环节的完成情况及衔接；模型选择包括按任务配置分析方法。

options.label: 1 分 · 关键环节未执行，未形成可用的完整实验过程
2 分 · 仅完成部分环节，关键处理、模型、记录或分析缺失
3 分 · 主要环节已执行，但存在未完成步骤或记录缺口
4 分 · 四个环节均已完成，主要输入、配置和输出可追溯
5 分 · 四个环节完整衔接，处理与模型配置、执行记录及结果分析均清楚可核查
无法判断（不计分）

questions.title: 这项研究结果增加了多少有意义的科学信息？
questions.help: 评价完整研究结果提供的科学信息与研究价值。

options.label: 1 分 · 没有可辨认的可信信息增量
2 分 · 主要重复已有认识，增量很小
3 分 · 提供有价值的复核、扩展或适用边界
4 分 · 对具体科学问题提供重要的新信息
5 分 · 对该问题的理解构成实质推进，值得深入研究
无法判断（不计分）

pre.title: 右侧 ROI312 与显著性/腹侧注意网络
pre.hypothesis: ROI_to_network:312:SalVentAttn；TCP预定全部病例（双相障碍、精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍）分别相对预定对照的平均Pearson r共同降低；不作疾病状态或其他亚组筛选。
pre.hypothesis_plain: 右侧 ROI312 分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络（SalVentAttn）之间的功能连接强度，在双相障碍患者和精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍患者中预计均低于各自的对照组——两组下降方向一致。
pre.definition: Schaefer-400 / 7-network；ROI312 = 7Networks_RH_SalVentAttn_Med_2。该分区到 SalVentAttn 的 46 条非对角 Pearson r 边的算术均值；不等同于整个同名解剖区。不作 Fisher 变换或结果驱动选边。
pre.rationale: 跨诊断动态FC示突显网络降低(P1)，突显网络同伦降低(P2)，患者短程连接降低(P3)，故该突显网络内边降低。
pre.transfer_limit: P1为动态FC、P2为同伦、P3为距离依赖，均非静态边级r；P3同时报告长程连接增高，方向异质；父节点5accc8b6联合稳定性0.51、成分beta近零。

references.recorded_sentence: The bipolar II depression group exhibited decreased functional connectivity between the right posterior insula and the left postcentral gyrus, and increased connectivity between the left anterior insula and the bilateral insula extending to the right putamen. The patients also showed higher IL-6 and TNF-alpha levels, and IL-6 level was negatively correlated with right posterior insula to left postcentral gyrus connectivity.

pre.source_note: 假设为检验前执行卡的程序渲染标题；理由和限制来自实际模型回答，仅规范化引文别名。

significance.zh: 若实验支持这一假设，研究者就能把两种诊断中共同的连接差异定位到显著性/腹侧注意网络的一个具体分区，进一步考察它是否与识别重要信息、排除干扰有关。临床研究可将这一连接指标与分心程度和注意转换测验配对，探索按认知困难而非仅按诊断标签组织注意训练的方式。
significance.en: If the experiments support this hypothesis, researchers could localize a shared connectivity difference to a specific parcel of the salience/ventral attention network, then test its relationship to recognizing important information and resisting distraction. Clinical studies could pair this measure with distractibility ratings and attention-switching tasks to explore attention training organized around cognitive difficulties rather than diagnosis alone.

rationale.zh: 已有研究在多种精神障碍中观察到显著性网络及相关连接的变化（P1–P3）。系统据此把问题缩小到右侧 ROI312：这个具体分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络的连接，是否在双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系中都降低？
rationale.en: Earlier studies reported changes in salience-network and related connectivity across psychiatric disorders (P1–P3). The system narrowed this question to right ROI312: is its connection to the salience/ventral attention network lower in both bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum?

feedback.zh: 系统此前测试过 ROI139 与同一网络的连接，两组虽然都呈下降方向，但重复抽样的一致性约为 51%。本轮改测 ROI312，并在模型角色讨论后修订了引用依据和对前序结果的解释。
feedback.en: The system previously tested ROI139 with the same network. Both groups showed a decrease, but the two directions agreed in only about 51% of resamples. This round tested ROI312 and revised the cited rationale and interpretation of the earlier result after discussion among model agents.

methods.zh: 使用静息态 fMRI，计算右侧 ROI312 与显著性/腹侧注意网络的平均连接强度，分别比较两类患者与对照。内部使用 TCP，外部在 UCLA 重复两类诊断比较，并在 COBRE、HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍相关结果。分析考虑年龄、性别和扫描站点，外部另检查头动影响；内部与外部分别进行 512 次和 2,000 次重复抽样，观察下降方向是否稳定。
methods.en: Resting-state fMRI was used to calculate mean connectivity between right ROI312 and the salience/ventral attention network, comparing each patient group with controls. TCP supplied the internal analysis; UCLA repeated both diagnostic comparisons, while COBRE and HCP-EP assessed psychosis-related findings. Analyses accounted for age, sex and site, with external checks for head motion. Internal and external analyses used 512 and 2,000 resamples, respectively, to assess directional stability.

results.zh: TCP 中双相障碍与精神分裂症谱系的标准化效应分别为 −0.552 和 −0.619；UCLA 对应比较为 −0.594 和 −0.514，均呈连接降低。两类诊断同时保持下降方向的重复抽样比例，在 TCP 为 95.1%、UCLA 为 99.3%。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的主要精神病性障碍比较也同向，标准化效应分别为 −0.472 和 −0.694。
results.en: Standardized effects were −0.552 for bipolar disorder and −0.619 for the schizophrenia spectrum in TCP, and −0.594 and −0.514 in the corresponding UCLA comparisons. All indicated lower connectivity. Both diagnoses retained the decreasing direction together in 95.1% of TCP resamples and 99.3% of UCLA resamples. The primary psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also agreed, with standardized effects of −0.472 and −0.694.

P1.zh: 跨诊断动态脑连接研究：在一种连接状态下，精神分裂症、双相障碍和抑郁症的视觉、感觉运动及显著性等网络内部连接均降低。
P1.en: A transdiagnostic dynamic-connectivity study found lower connectivity within visual, sensorimotor, salience and other networks in one connectivity state across schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and depression.

P2.zh: 左右半球对应区域的连接综述：多种精神障碍中报告了连接降低，但 ADHD 的研究并未呈现同样的一致模式。
P2.en: A review of connectivity between corresponding left- and right-hemisphere regions reported reductions across several psychiatric disorders, but not the same consistent pattern in ADHD.

P3.zh: 跨诊断脑网络研究：患者的短距离连接较低，中长距离连接较高，不同诊断还存在区域差异。
P3.en: A cross-disorder network study found lower short-range and higher medium- or long-range connectivity, with regional differences between diagnoses.

P4.zh: 跨诊断岛叶连接结果提供显著性网络的相关背景，但不能直接验证特定右侧 ROI312 到整个网络的平均连接。
P4.en: Cross-diagnostic insular connectivity provides salience-network context, not direct validation of mean connectivity from the specific right ROI312 to the whole network.

P5.zh: 涉及岛叶及感觉运动连接，并同时报告升高和降低；双相 II 型抑郁期样本不等同于本例全部病例或特定 ROI312。
P5.en: It examines insular and sensorimotor connectivity with both increases and decreases. Bipolar II depression is not equivalent to this case's full case groups or specific ROI312.

scale.zh: 4 个队列，共 2 项内部与 4 项外部主要比较。TCP：双相障碍 26 人、精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍 16 人、对照 91 人；UCLA：双相障碍 49 人、精神分裂症 49 人、对照 119 人。COBRE：精神分裂症谱系 74 人、对照 84 人；HCP-EP：非情感性早期精神病 90 人、对照 55 人。
scale.en: Four cohorts, with 2 internal and 4 primary external comparisons. TCP: 26 bipolar, 16 schizophrenia/schizoaffective and 91 control participants. UCLA: 49 bipolar, 49 schizophrenia and 119 control participants. COBRE: 74 schizophrenia-spectrum and 84 control participants. HCP-EP: 90 early non-affective psychosis and 55 control participants.

P1.title: Transdiagnostic time-varying dysconnectivity across major psychiatric disorders.

did.zh: 研究对 610 人的静息态 fMRI 进行动态连接分析，比较精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症与健康对照。在最常出现的连接状态中，三类患者的视觉、感觉运动、显著性及额顶网络内部连接均较低。
did.en: Dynamic resting-state connectivity was examined in 610 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. In the most frequent connectivity state, all three patient groups showed lower within-network connectivity in visual, sensorimotor, salience and frontoparietal networks.

relation.zh: 该研究提供了显著性网络跨诊断低连接的线索。本案例把动态网络层面的观察具体化为右侧 ROI312 到该网络的静态平均连接，并检验双相与精神分裂症谱系是否同向。
relation.en: The salience-network finding motivates a shared diagnostic pattern. This case turns a dynamic network-level observation into a specific static mean-connection test from right ROI312 in bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

P2.title: Reduced homotopic interhemispheric connectivity in psychiatric disorders: evidence for both transdiagnostic and disorder specific features.

did.zh: 这篇综述汇总多个精神疾病中左右脑同源区域的静息态连接研究。多种疾病在注意、显著性、感觉运动等网络出现同源连接降低，但 ADHD 的模式不同。
did.en: This review compared resting-state connectivity between matching regions in the two hemispheres across psychiatric disorders. Several disorders showed reduced homotopic connectivity in attention, salience and sensorimotor networks, whereas ADHD showed a different pattern.

relation.zh: 综述提示，连接降低可能跨越传统诊断分类。本案例进一步询问，这一共同方向能否出现在具体分区到显著性网络的连接中，而不仅是左右脑同源区域之间。
relation.en: The review motivates a cross-diagnostic decrease. This case asks whether the shared direction also appears between a specific parcel and the salience network, rather than only between matching regions across hemispheres.

P3.title: Shared and Distinct Functional Architectures of Brain Networks Across Psychiatric Disorders.

did.zh: 研究比较 512 名精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症患者及健康对照的脑网络。三类患者均出现短距离连接降低，主要涉及感觉及联合皮层；中、长距离连接则升高，其前额叶分布随疾病而异。
did.en: Brain networks were compared in 512 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. Short-range connectivity was reduced across patient groups, particularly in sensory and association cortex. Medium- and long-range connectivity increased, with different prefrontal distributions across disorders.

relation.zh: 共同的短程连接降低为跨诊断假设提供依据；同时存在的长程连接升高说明不能预设所有连接都下降。因此，本案例针对 ROI312 的指定连接单独检验方向。
relation.en: Shared short-range decreases motivate the hypothesis, while long-range increases show that direction depends on the connection. The ROI312 connection therefore requires its own directional test.

P4.title: Common and Specific Functional Activity Features in Schizophrenia, Major Depressive Disorder, and Bipolar Disorder.

did.zh: 研究在 271 名参与者中比较精神分裂症、抑郁症、双相障碍与健康对照的静息态活动和连接。三类患者均有岛叶连接降低，以及部分额叶、扣带区域活动降低，同时也存在各疾病特有的改变。
did.en: Resting-state activity and connectivity were compared across schizophrenia, depression, bipolar disorder and controls in 271 participants. The patient groups shared reduced insular connectivity and lower activity in some frontal and cingulate regions, alongside disorder-specific changes.

relation.zh: 跨诊断岛叶连接结果提供显著性网络的相关背景，但不能直接验证特定右侧 ROI312 到整个网络的平均连接。
relation.en: Cross-diagnostic insular connectivity provides salience-network context, not direct validation of mean connectivity from the specific right ROI312 to the whole network.

P5.title: Inflammation is associated with decreased functional connectivity of insula in unmedicated bipolar disorder.

did.zh: 研究比较 41 名未用药、处于抑郁发作期的双相 II 型患者与 68 名对照。患者右后岛叶与左中央后回连接降低，并与较高 IL-6 水平相关；另一些前岛叶连接则升高。
did.en: The study compared 41 unmedicated patients with bipolar II depression and 68 controls. Right posterior insula–left postcentral connectivity was lower and related to higher IL-6 levels, while some anterior-insular connections were increased.

relation.zh: 涉及岛叶及感觉运动连接，并同时报告升高和降低；双相 II 型抑郁期样本不等同于本例全部病例或特定 ROI312。
relation.en: It examines insular and sensorimotor connectivity with both increases and decreases. Bipolar II depression is not equivalent to this case's full case groups or specific ROI312.

source.zh: 双相障碍和精神分裂症／分裂情感性障碍患者中，左侧控制网络分区 ROI139 与显著性／腹侧注意网络的平均功能连接，是否都低于各自对照组？
source.en: Is mean functional connectivity between left control-network parcel ROI139 and the salience/ventral attention network lower in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder than in their respective controls?

feedback.zh: TCP 中两类患者的效应均为负，但较弱；重复抽样时，两组同时保持降低方向的比例为 51.0%。这一结果随原假设一起被传入后轮。
feedback.en: Both TCP patient groups had negative but relatively weak effects. The two groups simultaneously retained the decreasing direction in 51.0% of resamples. This result was supplied to a later round together with the original hypothesis.

next.zh: 在相同两类患者中，改测右侧显著性／腹侧注意网络分区 ROI312 与该网络其余分区的平均功能连接，预测它在两组中均低于对照。
next.en: In the same two diagnostic groups, test mean connectivity between right salience/ventral attention parcel ROI312 and the remaining parcels of that network, predicting lower connectivity than in controls in both groups.

change.zh: 研究对象由左侧控制网络的 ROI139 换为右侧显著性／腹侧注意网络的 ROI312；目标网络、患者组和“共同降低”的方向保持不变。本例就是这一子假设的检验。
change.en: The source parcel changed from left control-network ROI139 to right salience/ventral attention ROI312. The target network, patient groups and predicted shared decrease stayed the same. The present case tests this child hypothesis.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 使用已有的静息态功能连接数据，按本例锁定的脑区或网络端点提取平均 Pearson r，并与诊断分组和协变量对应。这里记录的是分析输入准备；现有执行材料没有显示重新进行原始 MRI 去噪、配准等预处理。
text.en: NeuroRuntime uses existing resting-state functional-connectivity data, extracts mean Pearson r for the region or network endpoint locked for this case, and aligns it with diagnostic groups and covariates. This documents analysis-input preparation; the execution materials do not show a new raw-MRI denoising or registration run.

text.zh: 按预先设定的连接分析方案采用 OLS，分别比较各病例组与对照，调整年龄、性别和站点；外部结果同时保留运动调整等敏感性配置。这是任务对应的模型配置，不是比较多种算法后选出最优模型。
text.en: The configured connectivity analysis uses OLS for each case group versus controls, adjusting for age, sex and site; external results retain sensitivity configurations including motion adjustment. This is task-specific model configuration, not selection of a best algorithm after a model competition.

text.zh: 已保存假设 ID、端点、seed/轮次、内部反馈及外部逐行结果；结果行包含队列、模型列、β、残差 RMS 和重采样方向频率，可按假设及来源记录对应回查。
text.en: Saved records include hypothesis IDs, endpoints, seeds/rounds, internal feedback and external result rows. Rows retain cohort, model columns, beta, residual RMS and resampled direction frequencies, linked back to the hypothesis and source records.

text.zh: 内部用 512 次、外部用 2,000 次重采样检查方向稳定性，并报告标准化效应及各队列结果。方向频率不是 P 值；下表和逐表分析保留具体效应与不同队列间的差异。

pre.source_note: 假设是检验前执行卡的程序渲染标题；理由和限制来自实际模型回答（引文别名规范化）。
pre.hypothesis_plain: 左侧 ROI108 分区与躯体运动网络（SomMot）之间的功能连接强度，在双相障碍患者和精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍患者中预计均低于各自的对照组——两组下降方向一致。

significance.zh: 这条连接把显著性/腹侧注意网络中的左侧分区与感觉运动系统联系起来。两类患者若都出现降低，下一步就可以用反应选择和简单指敲任务，区分困难更接近“选择何时行动”还是“完成动作”。对临床评估，这提供了联合检查注意、动作启动与执行速度的思路，使康复目标更具体。
significance.en: This connection links a left salience/ventral attention parcel to the sensorimotor system. A shared decrease would motivate combining response-selection and simple finger-tapping tasks to distinguish difficulty deciding when to act from difficulty executing a movement. Clinically, it suggests assessing attention, movement initiation and execution speed together to define more specific rehabilitation goals.

rationale.zh: 双相障碍的感觉运动连接研究，以及精神分裂症中的岛叶和视觉相关连接研究，为系统提供了相邻回路的线索（P1–P3）。系统进一步提出，左侧 ROI108 与感觉运动网络的联系可能是两类患者共同变化的一个具体位置。
rationale.en: Studies of sensorimotor connectivity in bipolar disorder and insular or visual-related connections in schizophrenia provided clues from related circuits (P1–P3). The system proposed left ROI108's connection to the sensorimotor network as a specific location that might change in both patient groups.

feedback.zh: 此前，系统发现两类患者的背侧注意—感觉运动网络连接均较低，重复抽样中两组同向的比例约为 96%。这次把网络层面的线索细化到尚未测试的左侧 ROI108。
feedback.en: An earlier experiment found lower dorsal attention–sensorimotor connectivity in both groups, with joint directional agreement in about 96% of resamples. The system refined that network-level clue to the previously untested left ROI108.

methods.zh: 从静息态 fMRI 提取左侧 ROI108 与感觉运动网络的平均连接强度，在 TCP 比较双相障碍、精神分裂症谱系患者与对照。UCLA 用于重复两类诊断比较，COBRE 与 HCP-EP 用于进一步检查精神病性障碍。模型考虑年龄、性别和站点，并检查头动影响；内部 512 次、外部 2,000 次重复抽样用于评估结果方向的稳定性。
methods.en: Mean resting-state connectivity between left ROI108 and the sensorimotor network was compared between patients and controls in TCP. UCLA repeated the bipolar and schizophrenia comparisons, while COBRE and HCP-EP provided additional psychosis comparisons. Models accounted for age, sex and site, with head-motion checks. Directional stability was assessed using 512 internal and 2,000 external resamples.

results.zh: TCP 的双相障碍与精神分裂症谱系标准化效应为 −0.707 和 −0.759，UCLA 对应为 −0.420 和 −0.599。两类诊断同时下降的重复抽样比例分别为 98.8% 和 98.9%。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的主要比较也呈下降，效应为 −0.582 和 −0.678；头动检查后方向未改变。
results.en: Standardized effects for bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum were −0.707 and −0.759 in TCP, versus −0.420 and −0.599 in UCLA. Both diagnoses decreased together in 98.8% and 98.9% of resamples, respectively. The primary COBRE and HCP-EP comparisons also decreased, with effects of −0.582 and −0.678. Head-motion checks did not change the direction.

P1.zh: 双相 I 型障碍研究：考察感觉运动网络的功能连接，以及它与执行功能困难的关系。
P1.en: A bipolar I disorder study examined sensorimotor-network connectivity and its relationship to executive-function difficulties.

P2.zh: 比较精神分裂症、抑郁症和双相障碍的脑功能活动，寻找共同变化及各诊断特有的表现。
P2.en: A comparison of brain functional activity in schizophrenia, depression and bipolar disorder examined shared changes and diagnosis-specific patterns.

P3.zh: 视觉言语任务研究：精神分裂症患者的左侧后颞下回活动及其与若干听觉、运动和岛叶区域的连接降低。
P3.en: During a visual-speech task, schizophrenia patients showed lower left posterior inferior temporal activity and connectivity with several auditory, motor and insular regions.

P4.zh: 动态感觉运动网络的跨诊断结果与本例相关，但动态网络内连接不等于左侧 ROI108 的静态网络平均连接。
P4.en: Cross-diagnostic dynamic sensorimotor-network findings are relevant, but within-network dynamic connectivity is not static mean connectivity from left ROI108.

P5.zh: 短程降低与长程升高提示连接方向依赖空间尺度；这是左侧 ROI108—感觉运动网络检验的背景，不是该精确端点的验证。
P5.en: Short-range decreases and long-range increases show dependence on spatial scale. This is context for the left ROI108–sensorimotor test, not validation of that exact endpoint.

scale.zh: 4 个队列，共 2 项内部与 4 项外部主要比较。TCP：双相障碍 26 人、精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍 16 人、对照 91 人；UCLA：双相障碍 49 人、精神分裂症 49 人、对照 119 人。COBRE：精神分裂症谱系 74 人、对照 84 人；HCP-EP：非情感性早期精神病 90 人、对照 55 人。
scale.en: Four cohorts, with 2 internal and 4 primary external comparisons. TCP: 26 bipolar, 16 schizophrenia/schizoaffective and 91 control participants. UCLA: 49 bipolar, 49 schizophrenia and 119 control participants. COBRE: 74 schizophrenia-spectrum and 84 control participants. HCP-EP: 90 early non-affective psychosis and 55 control participants.

P1.title: Aberrant Functional Connectivity of Sensorimotor Network and Its Relationship With Executive Dysfunction in Bipolar Disorder Type I.

did.zh: 研究比较 18 名双相 I 型患者与 20 名健康对照的感觉运动网络，并评估执行功能。患者部分网络内连接升高、感觉运动与默认模式网络间连接降低，一些连接差异与躁狂症状及数字广度表现相关。
did.en: Resting-state sensorimotor connectivity and executive function were studied in 18 people with bipolar I disorder and 20 controls. Patients showed increased connectivity in parts of the sensorimotor network but reduced connectivity with the default-mode network. Some differences related to mania symptoms and digit-span performance.

relation.zh: 该研究把感觉运动连接异常与双相障碍的执行功能联系起来，说明值得在该网络中寻找表型。它同时报告升高与降低，本案例因此对左侧 ROI108 的指定连接及跨诊断方向另行检验。
relation.en: The link with executive function motivates examining the sensorimotor network in bipolar disorder. Because the study found both increases and decreases, this case separately tests the specific ROI108 connection and its direction across diagnoses.

P2.title: Common and Specific Functional Activity Features in Schizophrenia, Major Depressive Disorder, and Bipolar Disorder.

did.zh: 研究在 271 名参与者中比较精神分裂症、抑郁症、双相障碍与健康对照的静息态活动和连接。三类患者均有岛叶连接降低，以及部分额叶、扣带区域活动降低，同时也存在各疾病特有的改变。
did.en: Resting-state activity and connectivity were compared across schizophrenia, depression, bipolar disorder and controls in 271 participants. The patient groups shared reduced insular connectivity and lower activity in some frontal and cingulate regions, alongside disorder-specific changes.

relation.zh: 三类疾病共享连接异常，为寻找共同脑表型提供背景。本案例把这一思路落到左侧 ROI108—感觉运动网络连接，集中比较双相与精神分裂症谱系。
relation.en: Shared abnormalities across disorders motivate a common imaging phenotype. This case focuses that idea on left ROI108–sensorimotor connectivity in bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

P3.title: Activation and Functional Connectivity of the Left Inferior Temporal Gyrus during Visual Speech Priming in Healthy Listeners and Listeners with Schizophrenia.

did.zh: 研究让 22 名精神分裂症患者和 16 名健康对照完成视觉言语提示任务。患者左后颞下回的任务激活较低，该区域与双侧中央沟盖、颞上回及左岛叶的连接也较弱。
did.en: A visual-speech priming task was studied in 22 people with schizophrenia and 16 controls. Patients showed lower task-related activation of the left posterior inferior temporal gyrus and weaker connectivity from that region to the Rolandic operculum, superior temporal gyri and left insula.

relation.zh: 视觉、言语与感觉运动相关区域之间的低连接，为本案例提供局部回路线索。当前问题则检验静息状态下分区到整个感觉运动网络的平均连接，并增加双相障碍比较。
relation.en: Weaker connections among visual, speech and sensorimotor-related regions provide a circuit-level clue. The current test concerns resting-state mean connectivity to the whole sensorimotor network and adds a bipolar comparison.

P4.title: Transdiagnostic time-varying dysconnectivity across major psychiatric disorders.

did.zh: 研究对 610 人的静息态 fMRI 进行动态连接分析，比较精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症与健康对照。在最常出现的连接状态中，三类患者的视觉、感觉运动、显著性及额顶网络内部连接均较低。
did.en: Dynamic resting-state connectivity was examined in 610 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. In the most frequent connectivity state, all three patient groups showed lower within-network connectivity in visual, sensorimotor, salience and frontoparietal networks.

relation.zh: 动态感觉运动网络的跨诊断结果与本例相关，但动态网络内连接不等于左侧 ROI108 的静态网络平均连接。
relation.en: Cross-diagnostic dynamic sensorimotor-network findings are relevant, but within-network dynamic connectivity is not static mean connectivity from left ROI108.

P5.title: Shared and Distinct Functional Architectures of Brain Networks Across Psychiatric Disorders.

did.zh: 研究比较 512 名精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症患者及健康对照的脑网络。三类患者均出现短距离连接降低，主要涉及感觉及联合皮层；中、长距离连接则升高，其前额叶分布随疾病而异。
did.en: Brain networks were compared in 512 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. Short-range connectivity was reduced across patient groups, particularly in sensory and association cortex. Medium- and long-range connectivity increased, with different prefrontal distributions across disorders.

relation.zh: 短程降低与长程升高提示连接方向依赖空间尺度；这是左侧 ROI108—感觉运动网络检验的背景，不是该精确端点的验证。
relation.en: Short-range decreases and long-range increases show dependence on spatial scale. This is context for the left ROI108–sensorimotor test, not validation of that exact endpoint.

source.zh: 双相障碍和精神分裂症／分裂情感性障碍患者的背侧注意网络与感觉运动网络之间，平均功能连接是否都低于各自对照组？
source.en: Is mean connectivity between the dorsal attention and sensorimotor networks lower in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder than in their respective controls?

feedback.zh: TCP 中两类患者均表现为连接降低；重复抽样中，两组共同保持降低方向的比例为 95.9%。系统随后把这一已测试的网络关系作为后轮输入。
feedback.en: Connectivity was lower in both TCP patient groups, with both groups retaining the decreasing direction in 95.9% of resamples. The system subsequently supplied this tested network relationship to a later round.

next.zh: 左侧 ROI108 与感觉运动网络的平均功能连接，在双相障碍及精神分裂症／分裂情感性障碍患者中是否也共同降低？ROI108 是显著性／腹侧注意网络中的一个分区。
next.en: Is mean connectivity between left ROI108 and the sensorimotor network also reduced in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder? ROI108 is a parcel of the salience/ventral attention network.

change.zh: 一端由整个背侧注意网络换为左侧 ROI108，另一端仍为感觉运动网络；保留两类诊断和降低方向。本例检验的是新的“分区—网络”连接，而非再次计算原来的两个网络均值。
change.en: One endpoint changed from the entire dorsal attention network to left ROI108; the other remained the sensorimotor network. The two diagnoses and decreasing direction were retained. This case tests a new parcel-to-network connection rather than recalculating the original network-to-network mean.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 使用已有的静息态功能连接数据，按本例锁定的脑区或网络端点提取平均 Pearson r，并与诊断分组和协变量对应。这里记录的是分析输入准备；现有执行材料没有显示重新进行原始 MRI 去噪、配准等预处理。

This documents analysis-input preparation; the execution materials do not show a new raw-MRI denoising or registration run.

text.zh: 按预先设定的连接分析方案采用 OLS，分别比较各病例组与对照，调整年龄、性别和站点；外部结果同时保留运动调整等敏感性配置。这是任务对应的模型配置，不是比较多种算法后选出最优模型。
text.en: The configured connectivity analysis uses OLS for each case group versus controls, adjusting for age, sex and site; external results retain sensitivity configurations including motion adjustment. This is task-specific model configuration, not selection of a best algorithm after a model competition.

text.en: Saved records include hypothesis IDs, endpoints, seeds/rounds, internal feedback and external result rows. Rows retain cohort, model columns, beta, residual RMS and resampled direction frequencies, linked back to the hypothesis and source records.

text.zh: 内部用 512 次、外部用 2,000 次重采样检查方向稳定性，并报告标准化效应及各队列结果。方向频率不是 P 值；下表和逐表分析保留具体效应与不同队列间的差异。
text.en: Internal analyses use 512 resamples and external analyses 2,000 to assess directional stability, alongside standardized effects and cohort-specific results. Direction frequency is not a P value; the tables and accompanying analyses retain the effects and differences between cohorts.

feedback.action_text: 承接[父假设]的双诊断低方向高稳定反馈，细化至新ROI 108。

discussion.text: 三位专家均认为证据异质性、P1无方向及固定范围限制充分；保留原卡，不把相邻回路线索或父反馈当作ROI直接效应。

pre.hypothesis_plain: 右侧 ROI254 分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络（SalVentAttn）之间的功能连接强度，在双相障碍患者和精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍患者中预计均低于各自的对照组——两组下降方向一致。

significance.zh: 这里关注的是右侧一个感觉运动分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络的联系。若预期得到支持，可以进一步检验：面对突然出现的重要刺激时，这条连接是否与动作准备和反应迟缓有关。临床上可将它作为候选影像指标，配合反应时测验，研究双相障碍与精神病性障碍中相似的动作反应困难。
significance.en: The focus is a right sensorimotor parcel and its connection to the salience/ventral attention network. Support for the hypothesis would motivate testing whether this connection relates to motor preparation and delayed responses to unexpected, important stimuli. As a candidate imaging measure paired with reaction-time tests, it could help clinical researchers investigate similar response difficulties in bipolar and psychotic disorders.

rationale.zh: 系统综合了岛叶、视觉加工和感觉运动连接的研究（P1–P3），提出右侧感觉运动分区 ROI254 可能与显著性/腹侧注意网络共同受影响。已有双相障碍研究报告过不同连接一降一升，因此本次实验直接检验这个特定连接是否在两类患者中都降低。
rationale.en: Combining studies of insular, visual-processing and sensorimotor connections (P1–P3), the system proposed a shared change involving right sensorimotor parcel ROI254 and the salience/ventral attention network. Because earlier bipolar research reported decreases in some connections and increases in others, this experiment tested the direction of this particular connection in both groups.

feedback.zh: 前序实验在 ROI054 与显著性/腹侧注意网络之间观察到两组共同下降，重复抽样一致性约为 95%。系统沿着这条线索转测 ROI254，同时在讨论中补充了文献里方向不同的结果。
feedback.en: An earlier experiment found a joint decrease between ROI054 and the salience/ventral attention network, with about 95% directional agreement across resamples. The system followed this clue to ROI254 and incorporated the differently directed findings from the literature during its discussion.

methods.zh: 测量右侧 ROI254 到显著性/腹侧注意网络的静息态平均连接，在 TCP 分别比较两类患者与对照。随后在 UCLA 重复双相与精神分裂症比较，并在 COBRE、HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍结果。分析调整年龄、性别和站点，另考察头动影响；通过内部 512 次、外部 2,000 次重复抽样，检查结果方向是否稳定。
methods.en: Mean resting-state connectivity from right ROI254 to the salience/ventral attention network was compared between each patient group and controls in TCP. UCLA repeated the bipolar and schizophrenia comparisons; COBRE and HCP-EP assessed psychosis-related results. Analyses adjusted for age, sex and site and examined head motion. Directional stability was checked with 512 internal and 2,000 external resamples.

results.zh: TCP 中双相障碍与精神分裂症谱系的标准化效应分别为 −0.561、−0.806，UCLA 分别为 −0.412、−0.485，均为下降。两类诊断同时同向的重复抽样比例为 TCP 96.9%、UCLA 98.6%。COBRE 与 HCP-EP 的主要比较同样下降，效应分别为 −0.492、−0.618。
results.en: Standardized effects were −0.561 and −0.806 for bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum in TCP, and −0.412 and −0.485 in UCLA. Both diagnoses retained the decreasing direction together in 96.9% of TCP and 98.6% of UCLA resamples. The primary COBRE and HCP-EP comparisons also decreased, with effects of −0.492 and −0.618.

P1.zh: 比较精神分裂症、抑郁症和双相障碍的脑功能活动，寻找共同变化及各诊断特有的表现。
P1.en: A comparison of brain functional activity in schizophrenia, depression and bipolar disorder examined shared changes and diagnosis-specific patterns.

P2.zh: 视觉言语任务研究：精神分裂症患者的左侧后颞下回活动及其与若干听觉、运动和岛叶区域的连接降低。
P2.en: During a visual-speech task, schizophrenia patients showed lower left posterior inferior temporal activity and connectivity with several auditory, motor and insular regions.

P3.zh: 未用药双相 II 型抑郁研究：部分岛叶—感觉运动连接降低，另一些岛叶连接升高，并考察了这些变化与炎症指标的关系。
P3.en: A study of unmedicated bipolar II depression found lower connectivity in some insular–sensorimotor connections and increases in others, and examined relationships with inflammatory markers.

P4.zh: 显著性网络的动态低连接与该主题相关，但不直接验证右侧 ROI254 到网络的静态均值。
P4.en: Dynamic salience-network hypoconnectivity is relevant, but does not directly validate static mean connectivity from right ROI254.

P5.zh: 提供跨诊断网络异常及空间尺度差异的背景；特定右侧 ROI254 的连接方向仍需本例独立检验。
P5.en: It provides cross-diagnostic network and spatial-scale context; the direction for the specific right ROI254 connection still requires this case's own test.

scale.zh: 4 个队列，共 2 项内部与 4 项外部主要比较。TCP：双相障碍 26 人、精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍 16 人、对照 91 人；UCLA：双相障碍 49 人、精神分裂症 49 人、对照 119 人。COBRE：精神分裂症谱系 74 人、对照 84 人；HCP-EP：非情感性早期精神病 90 人、对照 55 人。
scale.en: Four cohorts, with 2 internal and 4 primary external comparisons. TCP: 26 bipolar, 16 schizophrenia/schizoaffective and 91 control participants. UCLA: 49 bipolar, 49 schizophrenia and 119 control participants. COBRE: 74 schizophrenia-spectrum and 84 control participants. HCP-EP: 90 early non-affective psychosis and 55 control participants.

P1.title: Common and Specific Functional Activity Features in Schizophrenia, Major Depressive Disorder, and Bipolar Disorder.

did.zh: 研究在 271 名参与者中比较精神分裂症、抑郁症、双相障碍与健康对照的静息态活动和连接。三类患者均有岛叶连接降低，以及部分额叶、扣带区域活动降低，同时也存在各疾病特有的改变。
did.en: Resting-state activity and connectivity were compared across schizophrenia, depression, bipolar disorder and controls in 271 participants. The patient groups shared reduced insular connectivity and lower activity in some frontal and cingulate regions, alongside disorder-specific changes.

relation.zh: 岛叶及显著性网络的共同异常，是本案例选择显著性/腹侧注意网络的主要依据。当前实验进一步定位到右侧 ROI254，并检查两类诊断及外部队列是否呈同一方向。
relation.en: Shared insular and salience-network abnormalities motivate selecting the salience/ventral attention network. The present test narrows this to right ROI254 and examines agreement across two diagnoses and external cohorts.

P2.title: Activation and Functional Connectivity of the Left Inferior Temporal Gyrus during Visual Speech Priming in Healthy Listeners and Listeners with Schizophrenia.

did.zh: 研究让 22 名精神分裂症患者和 16 名健康对照完成视觉言语提示任务。患者左后颞下回的任务激活较低，该区域与双侧中央沟盖、颞上回及左岛叶的连接也较弱。
did.en: A visual-speech priming task was studied in 22 people with schizophrenia and 16 controls. Patients showed lower task-related activation of the left posterior inferior temporal gyrus and weaker connectivity from that region to the Rolandic operculum, superior temporal gyri and left insula.

relation.zh: 该研究提供了精神分裂症中视觉相关区域与岛叶、感觉运动相关区域连接较弱的线索。本案例把局部任务回路问题扩展为静息态的分区—网络比较，并纳入双相障碍。
relation.en: The study provides a clue about weaker visual-related connections to insular and sensorimotor-related regions in schizophrenia. This case extends the circuit question to a resting-state parcel-to-network comparison and includes bipolar disorder.

P3.title: Inflammation is associated with decreased functional connectivity of insula in unmedicated bipolar disorder.

did.zh: 研究比较 41 名未用药、处于抑郁发作期的双相 II 型患者与 68 名对照。患者右后岛叶与左中央后回连接降低，并与较高 IL-6 水平相关；另一些前岛叶连接则升高。
did.en: The study compared 41 unmedicated patients with bipolar II depression and 68 controls. Right posterior insula–left postcentral connectivity was lower and related to higher IL-6 levels, while some anterior-insular connections were increased.

relation.zh: 岛叶—感觉运动连接降低为双相障碍一侧提供了具体线索，与显著性网络研究形成互补。本案例不测量炎症，而是检验指定 ROI—网络连接能否成为两类诊断共有的影像表现。
relation.en: Reduced insula–sensorimotor connectivity provides a specific bipolar clue that complements the salience-network evidence. This case tests a shared imaging pattern in two diagnoses; it does not measure inflammation.

P4.title: Transdiagnostic time-varying dysconnectivity across major psychiatric disorders.

did.zh: 研究对 610 人的静息态 fMRI 进行动态连接分析，比较精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症与健康对照。在最常出现的连接状态中，三类患者的视觉、感觉运动、显著性及额顶网络内部连接均较低。
did.en: Dynamic resting-state connectivity was examined in 610 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. In the most frequent connectivity state, all three patient groups showed lower within-network connectivity in visual, sensorimotor, salience and frontoparietal networks.

relation.zh: 显著性网络的动态低连接与该主题相关，但不直接验证右侧 ROI254 到网络的静态均值。
relation.en: Dynamic salience-network hypoconnectivity is relevant, but does not directly validate static mean connectivity from right ROI254.

P5.title: Shared and Distinct Functional Architectures of Brain Networks Across Psychiatric Disorders.

did.zh: 研究比较 512 名精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症患者及健康对照的脑网络。三类患者均出现短距离连接降低，主要涉及感觉及联合皮层；中、长距离连接则升高，其前额叶分布随疾病而异。
did.en: Brain networks were compared in 512 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. Short-range connectivity was reduced across patient groups, particularly in sensory and association cortex. Medium- and long-range connectivity increased, with different prefrontal distributions across disorders.

relation.zh: 提供跨诊断网络异常及空间尺度差异的背景；特定右侧 ROI254 的连接方向仍需本例独立检验。
relation.en: It provides cross-diagnostic network and spatial-scale context; the direction for the specific right ROI254 connection still requires this case's own test.

source.zh: 左侧感觉运动分区 ROI054 与显著性／腹侧注意网络的平均功能连接，在双相障碍和精神分裂症／分裂情感性障碍患者中是否均低于对照？
source.en: Is mean connectivity between left sensorimotor parcel ROI054 and the salience/ventral attention network lower than in controls in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder?

feedback.zh: 这一连接在 TCP 的两类患者中均降低；传入后轮的结果显示，两组同时维持降低方向的重复抽样比例为 94.9%。
feedback.en: This connection was reduced in both TCP patient groups. The result supplied to the later round showed that both groups simultaneously retained the decreasing direction in 94.9% of resamples.

next.zh: 将研究分区换为右侧感觉运动分区 ROI254，检验它与同一显著性／腹侧注意网络的平均功能连接，是否也在两类患者中共同降低。
next.en: Change the source to right sensorimotor parcel ROI254 and test whether its mean connectivity with the same salience/ventral attention network is also reduced in both patient groups.

change.zh: 从左侧 ROI054 转向右侧 ROI254；保留目标网络、两类诊断和降低方向，以考察另一处感觉运动分区是否出现相似连接变化。本例报告的是 ROI254 的检验。
change.en: The source changed from left ROI054 to right ROI254, retaining the target network, two diagnoses and predicted decrease to examine another sensorimotor parcel. The present case reports the ROI254 test.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 使用已有的静息态功能连接数据，按本例锁定的脑区或网络端点提取平均 Pearson r，并与诊断分组和协变量对应。这里记录的是分析输入准备；现有执行材料没有显示重新进行原始 MRI 去噪、配准等预处理。
text.en: NeuroRuntime uses existing resting-state functional-connectivity data, extracts mean Pearson r for the region or network endpoint locked for this case, and aligns it with diagnostic groups and covariates. This documents analysis-input preparation; the execution materials do not show a new raw-MRI denoising or registration run.

text.zh: 按预先设定的连接分析方案采用 OLS，分别比较各病例组与对照，调整年龄、性别和站点；外部结果同时保留运动调整等敏感性配置。这是任务对应的模型配置，不是比较多种算法后选出最优模型。
text.en: The configured connectivity analysis uses OLS for each case group versus controls, adjusting for age, sex and site; external results retain sensitivity configurations including motion adjustment. This is task-specific model configuration, not selection of a best algorithm after a model competition.

text.zh: 已保存假设 ID、端点、seed/轮次、内部反馈及外部逐行结果；结果行包含队列、模型列、β、残差 RMS 和重采样方向频率，可按假设及来源记录对应回查。
text.en: Saved records include hypothesis IDs, endpoints, seeds/rounds, internal feedback and external result rows. Rows retain cohort, model columns, beta, residual RMS and resampled direction frequencies, linked back to the hypothesis and source records.

text.zh: 内部用 512 次、外部用 2,000 次重采样检查方向稳定性，并报告标准化效应及各队列结果。方向频率不是 P 值；下表和逐表分析保留具体效应与不同队列间的差异。
text.en: Internal analyses use 512 resamples and external analyses 2,000 to assess directional stability, alongside standardized effects and cohort-specific results. Direction frequency is not a P value; the tables and accompanying analyses retain the effects and differences between cohorts.

feedback.action_text: 承接[父假设]的双诊断低方向高稳定反馈，转检新ROI 254。

discussion.text: 按三位专家意见，补明P3双向结果及双相II抑郁语境，避免选择性报告并收紧共同低方向的跨阶段外推。

post.audit_note: 完整原始提议、六次模型评议、预检验锁定、真实父反馈和外部行均保留来源绑定。此页是汇总展示，不是重新运行实验。

significance.zh: 这一假设把问题从单个脑区扩大到整个感觉运动网络：两类患者的网络内部连接是否都较低。若成立，研究者可以进一步比较指敲、双手协调和感觉辨别表现，考察共同的运动功能困难。临床上的潜在用途是为精神运动迟缓或协调障碍提供可配合行为测验追踪的指标，用于评估运动康复过程。
significance.en: This hypothesis moves from an individual region to the whole sensorimotor network, asking whether its internal connectivity is lower in both patient groups. If supported, it would motivate comparisons of finger tapping, bimanual coordination and sensory discrimination. A potential clinical use is a measure to track alongside behavioral tests of psychomotor slowing or coordination difficulties during motor rehabilitation.

rationale.zh: 一项跨诊断研究发现，在某种动态连接状态下，双相障碍和精神分裂症等患者的感觉运动网络内部连接均降低（P1）。系统据此提出首轮假设：这种共同变化能否也体现在整个静息态扫描的网络平均连接上。
rationale.en: A transdiagnostic study found lower internal sensorimotor-network connectivity in a particular dynamic connectivity state across disorders including bipolar disorder and schizophrenia (P1). From this, the system proposed a first-round hypothesis: might the shared change also appear in mean network connectivity across the resting-state scan?

methods.zh: 将静息态 fMRI 中感觉运动网络内部各分区之间的连接汇总为平均指标，在 TCP 分别比较双相障碍、精神分裂症谱系患者与对照。在 UCLA 重复两类诊断比较，再用 COBRE 和 HCP-EP 检查精神病性障碍。模型考虑年龄、性别和站点，并考察头动；内部 512 次、外部 2,000 次重复抽样用于检查共同下降方向。
methods.en: Connections among sensorimotor parcels were averaged into a network-level resting-state measure and compared between patient groups and controls in TCP. UCLA repeated both diagnostic comparisons, with COBRE and HCP-EP providing psychosis comparisons. Models accounted for age, sex and site and examined head motion. The shared decreasing direction was assessed with 512 internal and 2,000 external resamples.

results.zh: TCP 中两类患者的标准化效应为 −0.687、−0.656，UCLA 为 −0.336、−0.545。两类诊断同时保持下降方向的重复抽样比例分别为 99.0% 与 97.1%。COBRE、HCP-EP 的主要比较也下降，效应为 −0.576、−0.791，说明观察到的同向模式也体现在网络整体指标上。
results.en: Standardized effects for the two patient groups were −0.687 and −0.656 in TCP, versus −0.336 and −0.545 in UCLA. Both diagnoses retained the decreasing direction together in 99.0% and 97.1% of resamples, respectively. Primary comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also decreased, with effects of −0.576 and −0.791. The shared direction was therefore also seen in a network-wide measure.

P1.zh: 跨诊断动态脑连接研究：在一种连接状态下，精神分裂症、双相障碍和抑郁症的视觉、感觉运动及显著性等网络内部连接均降低。
P1.en: A transdiagnostic dynamic-connectivity study found lower connectivity within visual, sensorimotor, salience and other networks in one connectivity state across schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and depression.

P2.zh: 直接涉及感觉运动网络，但双相 I 型患者部分网络内连接升高，与一概下降的解释不一致；ICA 局部连接也不等于本例全网络均值。作为相关的方向差异保留，不恢复为原假设支持。
P2.en: It directly concerns the sensorimotor network, but some within-network connections increased in bipolar I disorder, qualifying a uniform-decrease interpretation. Local ICA connectivity is not the whole-network mean. It is retained as a related directional difference, not restored as original support.

P3.zh: 作为跨诊断网络空间尺度的背景重新核查：短程和长程方向不同，并未直接检验本例 SomMot 网络内均值，不据此恢复历史支持信用。
P3.en: Reassessed as cross-diagnostic spatial-scale context: short- and long-range directions differ, and the study did not test this case's within-SomMot mean. No historical support credit is restored.

P4.zh: 这是跨诊断感觉运动回路的相关研究，但测量的是丘脑—皮层而非 SomMot 网络内部均值；升高结果不能被算作本假设的下降支持。
P4.en: This study concerns sensorimotor circuitry across diagnoses, but measures thalamocortical connectivity rather than the within-SomMot mean. Its increases must not be counted as support for the proposed decrease.

P5.zh: 提供精神病中感觉运动连接异常的背景与不同方向结果；不包含本例双相障碍与精神分裂症谱系的 SomMot 网络内均值检验。
P5.en: It supplies sensorimotor-connectivity context and a different directional result in psychosis, not this case's within-SomMot mean test across bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

scale.zh: 4 个队列，共 2 项内部与 4 项外部主要比较。TCP：双相障碍 26 人、精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍 16 人、对照 91 人；UCLA：双相障碍 49 人、精神分裂症 49 人、对照 119 人。COBRE：精神分裂症谱系 74 人、对照 84 人；HCP-EP：非情感性早期精神病 90 人、对照 55 人。
scale.en: Four cohorts, with 2 internal and 4 primary external comparisons. TCP: 26 bipolar, 16 schizophrenia/schizoaffective and 91 control participants. UCLA: 49 bipolar, 49 schizophrenia and 119 control participants. COBRE: 74 schizophrenia-spectrum and 84 control participants. HCP-EP: 90 early non-affective psychosis and 55 control participants.

P1.title: Transdiagnostic time-varying dysconnectivity across major psychiatric disorders.

did.zh: 研究对 610 人的静息态 fMRI 进行动态连接分析，比较精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症与健康对照。在最常出现的连接状态中，三类患者的视觉、感觉运动、显著性及额顶网络内部连接均较低。
did.en: Dynamic resting-state connectivity was examined in 610 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. In the most frequent connectivity state, all three patient groups showed lower within-network connectivity in visual, sensorimotor, salience and frontoparietal networks.

relation.zh: 这项研究直接提供了跨诊断感觉运动网络内部连接降低的线索。本案例沿用同一网络问题，但改用静态平均连接指标，并在多个外部队列中检查双相和精神分裂症谱系的结果方向。
relation.en: This study directly motivates a shared decrease within the sensorimotor network. The current case uses static mean connectivity and checks the bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum pattern across external cohorts.

P2.title: Aberrant Functional Connectivity of Sensorimotor Network and Its Relationship With Executive Dysfunction in Bipolar Disorder Type I.

did.zh: 研究比较 18 名双相 I 型患者与 20 名健康对照的感觉运动网络，并评估执行功能。患者部分网络内连接升高、感觉运动与默认模式网络间连接降低，一些连接差异与躁狂症状及数字广度表现相关。
did.en: Resting-state sensorimotor connectivity and executive function were studied in 18 people with bipolar I disorder and 20 controls. Patients showed increased connectivity in parts of the sensorimotor network but reduced connectivity with the default-mode network. Some differences related to mania symptoms and digit-span performance.

relation.zh: 直接涉及感觉运动网络，但双相 I 型患者部分网络内连接升高，与一概下降的解释不一致；ICA 局部连接也不等于本例全网络均值。作为相关的方向差异保留，不恢复为原假设支持。
relation.en: It directly concerns the sensorimotor network, but some within-network connections increased in bipolar I disorder, qualifying a uniform-decrease interpretation. Local ICA connectivity is not the whole-network mean. It is retained as a related directional difference, not restored as original support.

P3.title: Shared and Distinct Functional Architectures of Brain Networks Across Psychiatric Disorders.

did.zh: 研究比较 512 名精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症患者及健康对照的脑网络。三类患者均出现短距离连接降低，主要涉及感觉及联合皮层；中、长距离连接则升高，其前额叶分布随疾病而异。
did.en: Brain networks were compared in 512 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. Short-range connectivity was reduced across patient groups, particularly in sensory and association cortex. Medium- and long-range connectivity increased, with different prefrontal distributions across disorders.

relation.zh: 作为跨诊断网络空间尺度的背景重新核查：短程和长程方向不同，并未直接检验本例 SomMot 网络内均值，不据此恢复历史支持信用。
relation.en: Reassessed as cross-diagnostic spatial-scale context: short- and long-range directions differ, and the study did not test this case's within-SomMot mean. No historical support credit is restored.

P4.title: Thalamo-cortical functional connectivity in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.

did.zh: 静息态 fMRI 比较精神分裂症、双相障碍与对照，发现精神分裂症的丘脑内部及丘脑—额顶连接降低，而双相障碍的丘脑—躯体运动连接升高。
did.en: Resting-state fMRI compared schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and controls. Within-thalamic and thalamo-frontoparietal connectivity was reduced in schizophrenia, whereas thalamo-somatomotor connectivity increased in bipolar disorder.

relation.zh: 这是跨诊断感觉运动回路的相关研究，但测量的是丘脑—皮层而非 SomMot 网络内部均值；升高结果不能被算作本假设的下降支持。
relation.en: This study concerns sensorimotor circuitry across diagnoses, but measures thalamocortical connectivity rather than the within-SomMot mean. Its increases must not be counted as support for the proposed decrease.

P5.title: Mapping Thalamocortical Functional Connectivity in Chronic and Early Stages of Psychotic Disorders.

did.zh: 研究比较早期及慢性精神病患者与健康对照，发现前额叶—丘脑连接降低、躯体运动—丘脑连接升高，并考察连接与认知的关系。
did.en: The study compared early-stage and chronic psychosis with controls, finding reduced prefrontal-thalamic and increased somatomotor-thalamic connectivity and examining associations with cognition.

relation.zh: 提供精神病中感觉运动连接异常的背景与不同方向结果；不包含本例双相障碍与精神分裂症谱系的 SomMot 网络内均值检验。
relation.en: It supplies sensorimotor-connectivity context and a different directional result in psychosis, not this case's within-SomMot mean test across bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

next_research.zh: 本例在双相障碍和精神分裂症／分裂情感性障碍中观察到感觉运动网络内部连接降低，且方向较稳定。系统将这一内部实验结果带入下一轮，在保持同一网络测量的同时加入 ADHD，检验这种降低是否也出现在第三类疾病中。后续 TCP 实验中，三个诊断的效应方向均为降低，联合方向稳定性为 98.2%。研究由此从两类疾病的共同变化，推进到更广的跨诊断检验。
next_research.en: This case found lower connectivity within the sensorimotor network in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder, with a stable direction. The system carried this internal result into the next round and added ADHD while retaining the same network measure, asking whether the reduction also occurred in a third diagnostic group. In the subsequent TCP experiment, effects were negative in all three groups, with joint direction stability of 98.2%. The research thus progressed from a shared change in two disorders to a broader transdiagnostic test.

source.zh: 感觉运动网络内部各分区之间的平均功能连接，在双相障碍和精神分裂症／分裂情感性障碍患者中均低于各自对照组。
source.en: Mean connectivity among parcels within the sensorimotor network is lower in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder than in their respective controls.

feedback.zh: 本例 TCP 实验观察到两组均降低，联合方向稳定性为 99.0%；这个内部结果被提供给下一轮。
feedback.en: The TCP experiment found a decrease in both groups, with joint direction stability of 99.0%. This internal result was supplied to the next round.

next.zh: ADHD、双相障碍及精神分裂症／分裂情感性障碍三类患者，是否都存在同一个感觉运动网络内部连接降低的模式？三组分别与对照比较。
next.en: Do ADHD, bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder all show the same reduction in within-sensorimotor-network connectivity, with each diagnostic group compared separately against controls?

change.zh: 保持同一网络及平均连接指标，在原来的两类诊断之外加入 ADHD，检验共同模式能否扩展到第三类疾病。
change.en: Keep the same network and mean-connectivity measure, but add ADHD to the original two diagnoses to test whether the shared pattern extends to a third disorder.

outcome.zh: 子假设已完成 TCP 实验：三组效应均为负，联合方向稳定性为 98.2%。
outcome.en: The child hypothesis was tested in TCP: effects were negative in all three groups, with joint direction stability of 98.2%.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 使用已有的静息态功能连接数据，按本例锁定的脑区或网络端点提取平均 Pearson r，并与诊断分组和协变量对应。这里记录的是分析输入准备；现有执行材料没有显示重新进行原始 MRI 去噪、配准等预处理。
text.en: NeuroRuntime uses existing resting-state functional-connectivity data, extracts mean Pearson r for the region or network endpoint locked for this case, and aligns it with diagnostic groups and covariates. This documents analysis-input preparation; the execution materials do not show a new raw-MRI denoising or registration run.

text.zh: 按预先设定的连接分析方案采用 OLS，分别比较各病例组与对照，调整年龄、性别和站点；外部结果同时保留运动调整等敏感性配置。这是任务对应的模型配置，不是比较多种算法后选出最优模型。
text.en: The configured connectivity analysis uses OLS for each case group versus controls, adjusting for age, sex and site; external results retain sensitivity configurations including motion adjustment. This is task-specific model configuration, not selection of a best algorithm after a model competition.

text.zh: 已保存假设 ID、端点、seed/轮次、内部反馈及外部逐行结果；结果行包含队列、模型列、β、残差 RMS 和重采样方向频率，可按假设及来源记录对应回查。
text.en: Saved records include hypothesis IDs, endpoints, seeds/rounds, internal feedback and external result rows. Rows retain cohort, model columns, beta, residual RMS and resampled direction frequencies, linked back to the hypothesis and source records.

text.zh: 内部用 512 次、外部用 2,000 次重采样检查方向稳定性，并报告标准化效应及各队列结果。方向频率不是 P 值；下表和逐表分析保留具体效应与不同队列间的差异。
text.en: Internal analyses use 512 resamples and external analyses 2,000 to assess directional stability, alongside standardized effects and cohort-specific results. Direction frequency is not a P value; the tables and accompanying analyses retain the effects and differences between cohorts.

feedback.action_text: 无既往TCP反馈；本次按审阅收窄诊断与证据，仍仅作初始探索。

discussion.text: 回应生统、临床对ADHD外推和证据异质性的意见，按审阅聚焦P1并收窄诊断。

post.audit_note: 完整原始提议、六次模型评议、预检验锁定和外部行均保留来源绑定；该假设来自首轮提议，生成时同 seed 尚无已完成 TCP 反馈，无父假设。此页是汇总展示，不是重新运行实验。

pre.title: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量与内嗅皮层体积
pre.hypothesis: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline entorhinal volume.
pre.hypothesis_plain: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量越高，基线经颅内容积归一化的内嗅皮层体积预计越小。
pre.definition: 预测变量为 apoe_e4_dosage；结局为基线 Entorhinal_icv，即内嗅皮层体积除以颅内容积。
pre.rationale: 既有研究报告 APOE ε4 携带者在进展至痴呆后内嗅皮层萎缩更快。系统将这一线索转化为 ε4 剂量与基线内嗅皮层体积之间的关联假设。

methods.title: 数据集
methods.text: 内部分析使用 ADNI1/GO/2，外部分析使用 ADNI3；各模型的有效样本量见结果表。

methods.title: 测量与统计模型
methods.text: 使用基线结构 MRI 体积与遗传数据，调整年龄、性别、教育、遗传祖源 PC1–PC5 和站点。分别进行线性关联、秩关联和 Huber 稳健回归。

methods.title: 结果指标
methods.text: 线性与秩关联报告偏相关系数 r；Huber 模型报告标准化回归系数 β。P 为双侧检验值，q 为同任务、同 seed 全部配置的 FDR 校正值。

significance.zh: 内嗅皮层是记忆系统中的重要连接环节。这项假设若成立，就能把 APOE ε4 的携带数量与这一结构的个体差异联系起来，推动按 0、1、2 个 ε4 拷贝比较记忆表现和后续结构变化。对临床研究，它提示在遗传风险评估中纳入内嗅皮层测量，考察能否更早识别需要持续记忆随访的参与者。
significance.en: The entorhinal cortex is an important connection within the memory system. Support for this hypothesis would link APOE ε4 copy number to structural differences and motivate comparing memory and subsequent structural change across people with zero, one or two copies. Clinical research could examine whether adding entorhinal measurements to genetic-risk assessment helps identify participants for sustained memory follow-up.

rationale.zh: 已有随访研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在进展至痴呆后，内嗅皮层萎缩较快（P1）。系统把“随时间变化更快”的线索转成一个基线问题：ε4 拷贝数更多的人，内嗅皮层是否也较小？
rationale.en: A previous follow-up study found faster entorhinal atrophy in APOE ε4 carriers after progression to dementia (P1). The system translated that longitudinal clue into a baseline question: do people with more ε4 copies also have smaller entorhinal cortices?

methods.zh: 将 APOE ε4 的 0、1、2 个拷贝与基线内嗅皮层体积进行关联分析，再在 ADNI3 重复检验。体积按颅内容积归一化，模型考虑年龄、性别、教育、遗传祖源和站点。每个队列均比较线性关联、秩关联和 Huber 稳健回归三种方法，并对多重检验进行 FDR 校正。
methods.en: APOE ε4 dosage of zero, one or two copies was related to baseline entorhinal volume and tested again in ADNI3. Volume was normalized to intracranial volume, and models accounted for age, sex, education, genetic ancestry and site. Linear, rank-based and robust Huber analyses were compared in each cohort, with FDR adjustment for multiple testing.

results.zh: 内部和外部均为 313 人。线性分析中，ε4 拷贝数更多对应内嗅皮层较小，内部 r = −0.141、q = 0.0446，外部 r = −0.158、q = 0.0145。两队列的稳健回归也通过校正标准；秩关联仅在外部通过。六组分析均为负向，其中五组通过原统计标准。
results.en: Both cohorts included 313 participants. More ε4 copies were associated with smaller entorhinal volume in the linear analyses: internal r = −0.141, q = 0.0446; external r = −0.158, q = 0.0145. Robust regression also passed correction in both cohorts; rank-based association passed only externally. All six analyses were negative, and five met the original statistical criterion.

P1.zh: 纵向研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在进展至痴呆后，全脑、海马、内嗅皮层和颞中回萎缩较快，脑室扩大也较快。
P1.en: A longitudinal study found faster whole-brain, hippocampal, entorhinal and middle temporal atrophy, and faster ventricular enlargement, in APOE ε4 carriers after progression to dementia.

P2.zh: 直接涉及 APOE 与内嗅皮层结构，但重点是携带者内导航策略差异，并未证明 ε4 拷贝数与基线归一化体积呈线性关系。
P2.en: It directly concerns APOE and entorhinal structure, but focuses on navigation differences within carriers rather than a linear association between ε4 copy number and normalized baseline volume.

P3.zh: 帮助区分遗传风险和内嗅皮层结构两类指标；二者共同预测病程不等于 ε4 剂量必然导致更小的内嗅皮层体积。
P3.en: It distinguishes genetic risk from entorhinal structure: their joint prognostic value does not establish that greater ε4 dosage necessarily implies smaller entorhinal volume.

P4.zh: 提供影像遗传学测量与分析背景；APOE 在此为协变量，结局为萎缩率，不能视为 ε4 剂量—基线内嗅皮层体积的直接验证。ADNI 数据可能与本例重叠。
P4.en: It provides imaging-genetics methodology. APOE is a covariate and the outcome is atrophy rate, not a direct test of ε4 dosage against baseline entorhinal volume. ADNI data may overlap this case.

P5.zh: 直接关联 APOE 与内嗅皮层，但使用携带状态和皮层厚度，而本例使用剂量和归一化体积；A+T+ 筛选及 ADNI 队列重叠也限制迁移。
P5.en: It links APOE to entorhinal structure, but uses carrier status and cortical thickness rather than dosage and normalized volume. A+T+ selection and possible ADNI cohort overlap limit transfer.

scale.zh: 2 个数据批次：ADNI1/GO/2 内部分析 313 人，ADNI3 外部分析 313 人。每批数据使用 3 种关联方法，共 6 组分析。
scale.en: Two data phases: 313 participants in the internal ADNI1/GO/2 analysis and 313 in external ADNI3. Three association methods per cohort give six analyses.

P1.title: Segmented Linear Mixed Model Analysis Reveals Association of the APOEɛ4 Allele with Faster Rate of Alzheimer's Disease Dementia Progression.

did.zh: 研究随访 211 名从 MCI 进展至阿尔茨海默病痴呆的 ADNI 参与者，比较不同 APOE 基因型的认知及脑体积变化。ε4 携带者在进入痴呆阶段后，全脑、海马、内嗅皮层和颞中回萎缩较快，脑室扩大也较快。
did.en: The study followed 211 ADNI participants who progressed from MCI to Alzheimer's dementia, comparing cognitive and volumetric trajectories by APOE genotype. After dementia onset, ε4 carriers showed faster whole-brain, hippocampal, entorhinal and middle temporal atrophy, along with faster ventricular expansion.

relation.zh: 该研究将 ε4 与痴呆阶段更快的内嗅皮层萎缩联系起来。本案例把纵向变化线索转成基线剂量问题：ε4 拷贝数较多的人，入组时的内嗅皮层是否已经较小，并在另一批数据中检验。
relation.en: The study links ε4 with faster entorhinal atrophy during dementia. This case asks a baseline dosage question: do people with more ε4 copies already have smaller entorhinal volumes at enrollment, and does the association recur in another dataset?

P2.title: Healthy versus Entorhinal Cortical Atrophy Identification in Asymptomatic APOE4 Carriers at Risk for Alzheimer's Disease.

did.zh: 在无症状 APOE ε4 携带者中，采用非空间导航策略者比采用空间策略者表现出更明显的海马、内嗅皮层及海马伞萎缩；使用空间策略者的灰质水平与非携带者相近。
did.en: Among asymptomatic APOE ε4 carriers, non-spatial navigators showed greater hippocampal, entorhinal and fimbria atrophy than spatial navigators. Spatial navigators had grey-matter levels comparable to non-carriers.

relation.zh: 直接涉及 APOE 与内嗅皮层结构，但重点是携带者内导航策略差异，并未证明 ε4 拷贝数与基线归一化体积呈线性关系。
relation.en: It directly concerns APOE and entorhinal structure, but focuses on navigation differences within carriers rather than a linear association between ε4 copy number and normalized baseline volume.

P3.title: Relationship of medial temporal lobe atrophy, APOE genotype, and cognitive reserve in preclinical Alzheimer's disease.

did.zh: 研究随访245名起初认知正常者，发现内侧颞叶 MRI 指标、APOE ε4 与认知储备对 MCI 症状出现时间主要呈独立、相加的预测关系。
did.en: In 245 initially cognitively normal participants, medial-temporal MRI measures, APOE ε4 and cognitive reserve predicted MCI symptom onset largely independently and additively.

relation.zh: 帮助区分遗传风险和内嗅皮层结构两类指标；二者共同预测病程不等于 ε4 剂量必然导致更小的内嗅皮层体积。
relation.en: It distinguishes genetic risk from entorhinal structure: their joint prognostic value does not establish that greater ε4 dosage necessarily implies smaller entorhinal volume.

P4.title: Genetic interactions associated with 12-month atrophy in hippocampus and entorhinal cortex in Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative.

did.zh: ADNI 研究以海马和内嗅皮层12个月萎缩率为表型，检验通路内 SNP 交互作用，并把 APOE ε4 携带状态等作为协变量。
did.en: An ADNI study tested within-pathway SNP interactions against 12-month hippocampal and entorhinal atrophy, adjusting for APOE ε4 carrier status and other covariates.

relation.zh: 提供影像遗传学测量与分析背景；APOE 在此为协变量，结局为萎缩率，不能视为 ε4 剂量—基线内嗅皮层体积的直接验证。ADNI 数据可能与本例重叠。
relation.en: It provides imaging-genetics methodology. APOE is a covariate and the outcome is atrophy rate, not a direct test of ε4 dosage against baseline entorhinal volume. ADNI data may overlap this case.

P5.title: The effect of ApoE ε 4 on clinical and structural MRI markers in prodromal Alzheimer's disease.
P5.journal: Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery

did.zh: 在178名 ADNI A+T+ MCI 参与者中，APOE ε4 携带者的双侧内嗅皮层更薄、双侧海马体积更小，并有更明显的部分认知损害。
did.en: Among 178 ADNI A+T+ MCI participants, APOE ε4 carriers had thinner bilateral entorhinal cortices, smaller bilateral hippocampi and greater impairment in some cognitive domains.

relation.zh: 直接关联 APOE 与内嗅皮层，但使用携带状态和皮层厚度，而本例使用剂量和归一化体积；A+T+ 筛选及 ADNI 队列重叠也限制迁移。
relation.en: It links APOE to entorhinal structure, but uses carrier status and cortical thickness rather than dosage and normalized volume. A+T+ selection and possible ADNI cohort overlap limit transfer.

next_research.zh: 内嗅皮层与 APOE ε4 的内部分析结果，与海马和颞中回的结果一起进入了下一轮输入。后续候选中，系统继续关注内嗅皮层，但将遗传因素扩展为 GABA／谷氨酸通路的多基因风险，提出“该通路遗传风险越高，内嗅皮层体积越小”的假设。这一后续候选停留在提出阶段，未继续开展实验。
next_research.en: The internal APOE ε4–entorhinal result entered the next round alongside the hippocampal and middle temporal results. Among the subsequent candidates, the system retained the entorhinal cortex as a target but extended the genetic factor to polygenic risk in the GABA/glutamate pathway, proposing that higher pathway risk would be associated with smaller entorhinal volume. This follow-up remained a proposed hypothesis and did not proceed to an experiment.

source.zh: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量越高，基线经颅内容积归一化的内嗅皮层体积越小。
source.en: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline entorhinal volume normalized to intracranial volume.

feedback.zh: 本例内部主分析的关联为负（r = −0.141）。三种分析方法的结果，与 APOE ε4—海马及 APOE ε4—颞中回的结果，一同进入下一轮。
feedback.en: The primary internal association was negative (r = −0.141). Results from all three analysis methods entered the next round together with the APOE ε4–hippocampal and APOE ε4–middle temporal results.

next.zh: 在阿尔茨海默病谱系参与者中，GABA／谷氨酸通路的多基因风险评分越高，基线内嗅皮层体积是否越小？
next.en: Among participants on the Alzheimer's disease spectrum, is a higher GABA/glutamate pathway polygenic risk score associated with smaller baseline entorhinal volume?

change.zh: 保留内嗅皮层体积及“风险越高、体积越小”的预期关系，将遗传因素由 APOE ε4 剂量换为汇总一组通路相关遗传变异的风险评分。
change.en: Retain entorhinal volume and the expected higher-risk/smaller-volume relationship, but replace APOE ε4 dosage with a score summarizing genetic variants associated with a pathway.

outcome.zh: 该后轮候选可以映射到数据，但未被选入后续实验。
outcome.en: The later candidate could be mapped to the data but was not selected for a subsequent experiment.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 从已整理的 ADNI 遗传与访视表出发，按受试者合并最早访视，转换数值字段，并用颅内容积归一化脑区体积；ADNI1/GO/2 与 ADNI3 分别用于内部和外部分析。这是表格级处理，使用既有影像测量，不是重新处理原始 MRI。 对每个测量对排除非有限值；协变量进行缺失值填补、缩放和站点编码，交叉验证时这些处理仅在训练折拟合。
text.en: NeuroRuntime starts from prepared ADNI genetics and visit tables, joins each participant's earliest visit, converts numeric fields and normalizes regional volumes by intracranial volume. ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3 supply internal and external analyses respectively. This is table-level processing of existing imaging measurements, not a new raw-MRI preprocessing run. Non-finite measurement pairs are excluded; covariates undergo missing-value imputation, scaling and site encoding, fitted only on the training fold during cross-validation.

text.zh: 对入选测量对按登记方案运行线性偏相关、秩偏相关和 Huber 稳健回归三种配置，调整年龄、性别、教育、遗传主成分和站点。三种结果全部保留，不按显著性择优报告。
text.en: Each selected measurement pair receives the registered linear partial-correlation, rank partial-correlation and robust Huber configurations, adjusting for age, sex, education, ancestry principal components and site. All three are retained rather than selecting the most significant result.

text.zh: 逐配置记录包含假设与配置 ID、seed、内部/外部阶段、开始与结束时间、完成状态、主结果、交叉验证结果、警告及失败字段；configuration_ledger 汇集配置执行记录，final_readout 汇总结果。本例的三个配置在内部及外部均记录为 complete。
text.en: Per-configuration records contain hypothesis and configuration IDs, seed, internal/external phase, start and finish times, completion status, primary and cross-validation results, warnings and failure fields. The configuration_ledger collects execution records and final_readout summarizes results. All three configurations for this case are recorded as complete in both internal and external analyses.

text.zh: 分别报告内部与外部的样本量、效应、P 值及按任务/seed 校正的 FDR q 值；线性与秩方法报告 r，Huber 报告标准化 β。内部另有五折交叉验证记录，未通过的配置与队列差异仍显示在结果中。
text.en: Internal and external analyses report sample size, effect, P value and task/seed-level FDR q value. Linear and rank methods report r; Huber reports standardized beta. Internal five-fold cross-validation is also recorded; non-passing configurations and cohort differences remain visible.

pre.title: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量与海马体积
pre.hypothesis: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline hippocampal volume.
pre.hypothesis_plain: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量越高，基线经颅内容积归一化的海马体积预计越小。
pre.definition: 预测变量为 apoe_e4_dosage；结局为基线 Hippocampus_icv，即海马体积除以颅内容积。
pre.rationale: 既有队列研究报告 APOE ε4 纯合子具有较小的海马。系统进一步以 ε4 剂量作为连续变量，检验其与基线海马体积的关系。

methods.title: 数据集
methods.text: 内部分析使用 ADNI1/GO/2，外部分析使用 ADNI3；各模型的有效样本量见结果表。

methods.title: 测量与统计模型
methods.text: 使用基线结构 MRI 体积与遗传数据，调整年龄、性别、教育、遗传祖源 PC1–PC5 和站点。分别进行线性关联、秩关联和 Huber 稳健回归。

methods.title: 结果指标
methods.text: 线性与秩关联报告偏相关系数 r；Huber 模型报告标准化回归系数 β。P 为双侧检验值，q 为同任务、同 seed 全部配置的 FDR 校正值。

significance.zh: 这里把 APOE ε4 的 0、1、2 个拷贝与海马大小对应起来，将抽象的遗传风险转化为可测量的脑结构问题。若剂量关系得到支持，可进一步研究同样携带 ε4 的人为何表现出不同的记忆与脑结构状态。临床上的潜在意义是结合基因型、海马 MRI 和记忆测验设计随访分层，而不只依据是否携带 ε4。
significance.en: This case relates zero, one or two APOE ε4 copies to hippocampal size, translating genetic risk into a measurable brain-structure question. A supported dose relationship would motivate studying why carriers differ in memory and structural status. A potential clinical use is to investigate follow-up stratification that combines genotype, hippocampal MRI and memory testing rather than ε4 carrier status alone.

rationale.zh: 既有队列研究观察到，携带两个 APOE ε4 拷贝的人海马较小（P1）。系统进一步按 0、1、2 个拷贝检验剂量关系，询问拷贝数增加是否对应海马体积的连续变化。
rationale.en: An earlier cohort study observed smaller hippocampi in people with two APOE ε4 copies (P1). The system extended this to a dosage test across zero, one and two copies, asking whether increasing copy number corresponds to a graded difference in hippocampal volume.

methods.zh: 利用基因型与基线结构 MRI，检验 APOE ε4 拷贝数是否随海马体积减小而增加，并在 ADNI3 重复分析。海马体积按颅内容积归一化，模型考虑年龄、性别、教育、遗传祖源和站点。除线性关联外，还使用秩关联和 Huber 稳健回归，并进行 FDR 多重检验校正。
methods.en: Genotype and baseline structural MRI were used to test whether higher APOE ε4 dosage accompanies smaller hippocampal volume, followed by an ADNI3 analysis. Volume was normalized to intracranial volume; models accounted for age, sex, education, genetic ancestry and site. Rank-based association and robust Huber regression complemented the linear analysis, with FDR adjustment.

results.zh: 内部 326 人、外部 313 人的线性分析均支持负向关联：r 分别为 −0.185、−0.160，q 分别为 0.0070、0.0145。稳健回归在两队列中也得到支持。六组分析中五组通过原统计标准；唯一未通过的是外部秩关联（q = 0.1186），其方向仍为负。
results.en: Linear analyses in 326 internal and 313 external participants both supported a negative association: r = −0.185 and −0.160, with q = 0.0070 and 0.0145. Robust regression also supported the association in both cohorts. Five of the six analyses met the original statistical criterion; the external rank association did not (q = 0.1186), although its direction remained negative.

P1.zh: 大型队列研究：APOE ε4 纯合子海马和杏仁核较小，并表现出更明显的随年龄增长的认知下降。
P1.en: A large cohort study reported smaller hippocampi and amygdalae and greater age-related cognitive decline in APOE ε4 homozygotes.

P2.zh: 与基线海马体积假设密切相关，同时提示基线大小和后续变化率应分开；携带状态比较仍不等于连续剂量效应。
P2.en: It is closely related to baseline hippocampal volume and distinguishes initial size from subsequent change. A carrier comparison is still not a continuous dosage effect.

P3.zh: 这是与 APOE—海马体积假设直接相关的零结果，提示效应可能依赖人群和体积校正方式，不能只列同向结果。
P3.en: This directly relevant null finding cautions that APOE–hippocampal associations may depend on population and volume adjustment; it is not supporting evidence for a decrease.

P4.zh: 直接关联 APOE 与海马基线结构，但强调疾病和年龄背景；不能把跨等位基因组差异直接等同于本例0、1、2拷贝的剂量斜率。
P4.en: It directly relates APOE to baseline hippocampal structure while emphasizing disease and age context. Differences across allele groups are not identical to this case's 0/1/2-copy dosage slope.

P5.zh: 提供 APOE 调节海马结构—认知关系的纵向背景，不直接检验剂量与基线海马体积的关系。
P5.en: It provides longitudinal context for APOE modulation of hippocampal–cognitive relationships, not a direct test of dosage against baseline hippocampal volume.

scale.zh: 2 个数据批次：ADNI1/GO/2 内部分析 326 人，ADNI3 外部分析 313 人。每批数据使用 3 种关联方法，共 6 组分析。
scale.en: Two data phases: 326 participants in the internal ADNI1/GO/2 analysis and 313 in external ADNI3. Three association methods per cohort give six analyses.

P1.title: Impact of APOE, Klotho, and sex on cognitive decline with aging.
P1.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

did.zh: 研究分析 320,861 人的认知数据及 29,510 人的脑影像，考察 APOE、Klotho、年龄和性别。APOE ε4 纯合子表现出更明显的年龄相关认知下降，海马和杏仁核也较小。
did.en: The study examined APOE, Klotho, age and sex using cognitive data from 320,861 people and imaging from 29,510. APOE ε4 homozygotes showed greater age-related cognitive decline and smaller hippocampi and amygdalae.

relation.zh: 既有研究已观察到 ε4 纯合子海马较小，提供了基因型与脑结构的直接线索。本案例进一步按 0、1、2 个拷贝检验剂量关系，并在 ADNI 的两个数据批次中检查关联能否重现。
relation.en: The observation of smaller hippocampi in ε4 homozygotes provides direct genotype–structure evidence. This case tests dosage across zero, one and two copies and examines whether the association recurs in two ADNI data phases.

P2.title: APOE-epsilon4 and aging of medial temporal lobe gray matter in healthy adults older than 50 years.

did.zh: 对认知正常的中老年人进行纵向 MRI 随访，发现 ε4 携带者起初海马体积较小，但其海马萎缩速度并未比 ε3 纯合子更快。
did.en: Longitudinal MRI in cognitively normal middle-aged and older adults found smaller initial hippocampal volumes in ε4 carriers, but no faster hippocampal atrophy than in ε3 homozygotes.

relation.zh: 与基线海马体积假设密切相关，同时提示基线大小和后续变化率应分开；携带状态比较仍不等于连续剂量效应。
relation.en: It is closely related to baseline hippocampal volume and distinguishes initial size from subsequent change. A carrier comparison is still not a continuous dosage effect.

P3.title: Alzheimer's disease susceptibility genes APOE and TOMM40, and hippocampal volumes in the Lothian birth cohort 1936.

did.zh: Lothian Birth Cohort 1936 的老年社区样本中，APOE 或 TOMM40 基因型与海马体积未呈显著关联，无论使用原始体积还是颅内容积/全脑组织体积校正。
did.en: In older community participants from the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936, neither APOE nor TOMM40 genotype was significantly associated with hippocampal volume, whether raw or adjusted for intracranial or total brain-tissue volume.

relation.zh: 这是与 APOE—海马体积假设直接相关的零结果，提示效应可能依赖人群和体积校正方式，不能只列同向结果。
relation.en: This directly relevant null finding cautions that APOE–hippocampal associations may depend on population and volume adjustment; it is not supporting evidence for a decrease.

P4.title: A Multi-Cohort Study of ApoE ɛ4 and Amyloid-β Effects on the Hippocampus in Alzheimer's Disease.

did.zh: 多队列研究比较 APOE、淀粉样蛋白与基线海马体积；AD/MCI 中 ε4 携带者体积较小，ε4 与淀粉样蛋白阳性共同出现时更明显，但健康青少年未见 APOE 组间差异。
did.en: A multi-cohort study related APOE and amyloid to baseline hippocampal volume. ε4 carriers with AD/MCI had smaller volumes, particularly with amyloid positivity, whereas healthy adolescents showed no APOE-group differences.

relation.zh: 直接关联 APOE 与海马基线结构，但强调疾病和年龄背景；不能把跨等位基因组差异直接等同于本例0、1、2拷贝的剂量斜率。
relation.en: It directly relates APOE to baseline hippocampal structure while emphasizing disease and age context. Differences across allele groups are not identical to this case's 0/1/2-copy dosage slope.

P5.title: Longitudinal association between hippocampus atrophy and episodic-memory decline in non-demented APOE ε4 carriers.

did.zh: Lifebrain 纵向研究分析748名无痴呆者的海马体积和情景记忆，发现体积变化与记忆变化的关联在 ε4 携带者中更明显。
did.en: A longitudinal Lifebrain study of 748 non-demented participants found stronger coupling between hippocampal-volume change and episodic-memory change in ε4 carriers.

relation.zh: 提供 APOE 调节海马结构—认知关系的纵向背景，不直接检验剂量与基线海马体积的关系。
relation.en: It provides longitudinal context for APOE modulation of hippocampal–cognitive relationships, not a direct test of dosage against baseline hippocampal volume.

next_research.zh: 海马体积较小与 APOE ε4 剂量较高的内部关联，被连同另外两个脑区的结果提供给下一轮。该轮随后提出了不同于单一 APOE 位点的研究问题，例如孟德尔型阿尔茨海默病相关通路的多基因风险是否与脑室扩大相关，以及 GABA／谷氨酸通路风险是否与内嗅皮层体积较小相关。这些通路层面的候选尚未进入实验检验。
next_research.en: The internal association between higher APOE ε4 dosage and smaller hippocampal volume was supplied to the next round together with results from two other regions. That round then proposed questions beyond the single APOE locus, including whether polygenic risk in a Mendelian Alzheimer's disease pathway was associated with larger ventricles and whether GABA/glutamate pathway risk was associated with smaller entorhinal volume. These pathway-level candidates did not proceed to experimental testing.

source.zh: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量越高，基线经颅内容积归一化的海马体积越小。
source.en: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline hippocampal volume normalized to intracranial volume.

feedback.zh: 海马的内部主分析显示负向关联（r = −0.185），另外两种分析方向相同。该结果连同内嗅皮层和颞中回的 APOE ε4 关联结果一起传入下一轮。
feedback.en: The primary internal hippocampal analysis showed a negative association (r = −0.185), with the same direction in the other two analyses. These results entered the next round alongside the APOE ε4 associations with entorhinal and middle temporal volumes.

next.zh: 孟德尔型阿尔茨海默病相关通路的多基因风险评分越高，基线脑室体积是否越大？
next.en: Is a higher polygenic risk score for a Mendelian Alzheimer's disease pathway associated with larger baseline ventricular volume?

next.zh: GABA／谷氨酸通路的多基因风险评分越高，基线内嗅皮层体积是否越小？
next.en: Is a higher GABA/glutamate pathway polygenic risk score associated with smaller baseline entorhinal volume?

change.zh: 后轮的遗传因素从 APOE ε4 剂量扩展为通路风险评分；影像对象从海马换为脑室或内嗅皮层，分别检验“风险越高、脑室越大”和“风险越高、内嗅皮层越小”。
change.en: The later candidates replace APOE ε4 dosage with pathway risk scores and move from hippocampal volume to ventricular or entorhinal volume, testing higher-risk/larger-ventricle and higher-risk/smaller-entorhinal relationships, respectively.

outcome.zh: 两条候选均可映射到数据，但未被选入后续实验。
outcome.en: Both candidates could be mapped to the data, but neither was selected for a subsequent experiment.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 从已整理的 ADNI 遗传与访视表出发，按受试者合并最早访视，转换数值字段，并用颅内容积归一化脑区体积；ADNI1/GO/2 与 ADNI3 分别用于内部和外部分析。这是表格级处理，使用既有影像测量，不是重新处理原始 MRI。 对每个测量对排除非有限值；协变量进行缺失值填补、缩放和站点编码，交叉验证时这些处理仅在训练折拟合。
text.en: NeuroRuntime starts from prepared ADNI genetics and visit tables, joins each participant's earliest visit, converts numeric fields and normalizes regional volumes by intracranial volume. ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3 supply internal and external analyses respectively. This is table-level processing of existing imaging measurements, not a new raw-MRI preprocessing run. Non-finite measurement pairs are excluded; covariates undergo missing-value imputation, scaling and site encoding, fitted only on the training fold during cross-validation.

text.zh: 对入选测量对按登记方案运行线性偏相关、秩偏相关和 Huber 稳健回归三种配置，调整年龄、性别、教育、遗传主成分和站点。三种结果全部保留，不按显著性择优报告。
text.en: Each selected measurement pair receives the registered linear partial-correlation, rank partial-correlation and robust Huber configurations, adjusting for age, sex, education, ancestry principal components and site. All three are retained rather than selecting the most significant result.

text.zh: 逐配置记录包含假设与配置 ID、seed、内部/外部阶段、开始与结束时间、完成状态、主结果、交叉验证结果、警告及失败字段；configuration_ledger 汇集配置执行记录，final_readout 汇总结果。本例的三个配置在内部及外部均记录为 complete。
text.en: Per-configuration records contain hypothesis and configuration IDs, seed, internal/external phase, start and finish times, completion status, primary and cross-validation results, warnings and failure fields. The configuration_ledger collects execution records and final_readout summarizes results. All three configurations for this case are recorded as complete in both internal and external analyses.

text.zh: 分别报告内部与外部的样本量、效应、P 值及按任务/seed 校正的 FDR q 值；线性与秩方法报告 r，Huber 报告标准化 β。内部另有五折交叉验证记录，未通过的配置与队列差异仍显示在结果中。
text.en: Internal and external analyses report sample size, effect, P value and task/seed-level FDR q value. Linear and rank methods report r; Huber reports standardized beta. Internal five-fold cross-validation is also recorded; non-passing configurations and cohort differences remain visible.

pre.title: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量与颞中回体积
pre.hypothesis: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline middle-temporal volume.
pre.hypothesis_plain: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量越高，基线经颅内容积归一化的颞中回体积预计越小。
pre.definition: 预测变量为 apoe_e4_dosage；结局为基线 MidTemp_icv，即颞中回体积除以颅内容积。
pre.rationale: 既有研究将 APOE ε4 与更快的颞中回萎缩联系起来。系统据此检验 ε4 剂量是否与较小的基线颞中回体积相关。

references.title: Segmented Linear Mixed Model Analysis Reveals Association of the APOEɛ4 Allele with Faster Rate of Alzheimer's Disease Dementia Progression.
references.recorded_sentence: ε4 carriers demonstrated faster rates of atrophy of the whole brain, hippocampus, entorhinal cortex, middle temporal gyrus, and ventricular expansion after transitioning to dementia.

references.title: Morphological and Structural Network Analysis of Sporadic Alzheimer's Disease Brains Based on the APOE4 Gene.
references.verification: Owning cached PubMed abstract reviewed 2026-09-22; relevance is not independent replication.

references.recorded_sentence: The study examined structural MRI, grey-matter volume and structural networks in AD and controls in the context of APOE4, reporting reduced right middle-temporal and other regional grey-matter volumes in AD.

references.verification: Owning cached PubMed abstract reviewed 2026-09-22; relevance is not independent replication.

references.verification: Owning cached PubMed abstract reviewed 2026-09-22; relevance is not independent replication.
references.note: 直接涉及 APOE 和颞中回灰质结构，但携带状态、VBM 萎缩模式与本例连续剂量—归一化体积并非同一统计量。
references.recorded_sentence: Baseline VBM in 65 participants with amnestic MCI found greater grey-matter atrophy in APOE ε4 carriers in hippocampal, superior-temporal and middle-temporal regions, and examined joint effects with MAPT.

references.verification: Owning cached PubMed abstract reviewed 2026-09-22; relevance is not independent replication.
