methods.title: 数据集
methods.text: 内部分析使用 ADNI1/GO/2，外部分析使用 ADNI3；各模型的有效样本量见结果表。

methods.title: 测量与统计模型
methods.text: 使用基线结构 MRI 体积与遗传数据，调整年龄、性别、教育、遗传祖源 PC1–PC5 和站点。分别进行线性关联、秩关联和 Huber 稳健回归。

methods.title: 结果指标
methods.text: 线性与秩关联报告偏相关系数 r；Huber 模型报告标准化回归系数 β。P 为双侧检验值，q 为同任务、同 seed 全部配置的 FDR 校正值。

significance.zh: 颞中回使研究视野从海马扩展到外侧颞叶。若其体积也与 APOE ε4 剂量相关，就可进一步比较遗传风险在不同颞叶结构中的表现，并加入命名、词义理解等测验研究认知差异。临床研究的价值在于把语言与语义功能纳入随访，探索仅关注记忆表现时可能遗漏的变化。
significance.en: The middle temporal gyrus extends the focus beyond the hippocampus to lateral temporal cortex. A relationship with APOE ε4 dosage would motivate comparing genetic-risk associations across temporal structures and adding naming or word-meaning tests to study cognitive differences. Clinically, this suggests including language and semantic function in follow-up research to investigate changes that memory-focused assessments might miss.

rationale.zh: APOE ε4 与较快颞中回萎缩的既有观察（P1），使系统把关注点从海马扩展到外侧颞叶。本次检验的是基线体积：ε4 拷贝数较多的人，颞中回是否也较小。
rationale.en: An earlier observation linking APOE ε4 to faster middle temporal atrophy (P1) prompted the system to extend its focus beyond the hippocampus to lateral temporal cortex. This experiment concerned baseline size: do people with more ε4 copies have smaller middle temporal gyri?

methods.zh: 使用 ADNI1/GO/2 和 ADNI3 的基因型与结构 MRI，分析 APOE ε4 拷贝数与基线颞中回体积。体积按颅内容积归一化，分析考虑年龄、性别、教育、遗传祖源及站点。每个队列分别使用线性、秩关联与 Huber 稳健回归三种方法，并进行 FDR 校正。
methods.en: Genotype and structural MRI from ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3 were used to relate APOE ε4 dosage to baseline middle temporal volume. Volume was normalized to intracranial volume, accounting for age, sex, education, genetic ancestry and site. Linear, rank-based and robust Huber analyses were performed separately in each cohort, with FDR adjustment.

results.zh: 两队列各 313 人，但支持程度不同。内部线性关联接近零（r = −0.034，q = 0.7579），外部关联较明显（r = −0.199，q = 0.0043）。内部三种分析均未通过原统计标准，外部三种均通过；所有分析方向一致，实验证据主要来自 ADNI3。
results.en: Each cohort included 313 participants, but support differed. The internal linear association was close to zero (r = −0.034, q = 0.7579), while the external association was stronger (r = −0.199, q = 0.0043). None of the three internal analyses met the original statistical criterion; all three external analyses did. Directions agreed, with support mainly from ADNI3.

P1.zh: 纵向研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在进展至痴呆后，全脑、海马、内嗅皮层和颞中回萎缩较快，脑室扩大也较快。
P1.en: A longitudinal study found faster whole-brain, hippocampal, entorhinal and middle temporal atrophy, and faster ventricular enlargement, in APOE ε4 carriers after progression to dementia.

P2.zh: 涉及同一颞中回结构和 APOE 研究背景，但摘要中的 AD—对照差异不能被解释成 ε4 剂量对归一化体积的独立效应。
P2.en: It concerns the same middle-temporal structure and APOE context, but the abstract's AD–control contrast cannot be interpreted as an independent ε4-dosage effect on normalized volume.

P3.zh: 作为性别与测量选择的相关背景；颞中皮层的性别差异不是 APOE 效应，厚度也不等于本例体积，不据此声称支持剂量假设。
P3.en: This is context for sex and measurement choice. A middle-temporal sex difference is not an APOE effect, and thickness is not this case's volume measure; it does not establish the dosage hypothesis.

P4.zh: 直接涉及 APOE 和颞中回灰质结构，但携带状态、VBM 萎缩模式与本例连续剂量—归一化体积并非同一统计量。
P4.en: It directly concerns APOE and middle-temporal grey matter, but carrier status and VBM atrophy patterns are not identical to continuous dosage against normalized regional volume.

P5.zh: 提供剂量分组和颞叶形态背景，但颞中回结果属于白质，不能直接当作本例颞中回皮层体积降低的证据。
P5.en: It provides dosage-group and temporal-morphology context, but the middle-temporal result concerns white matter, not direct evidence for lower middle-temporal cortical volume in this case.

scale.zh: 2 个数据批次：ADNI1/GO/2 内部分析 313 人，ADNI3 外部分析 313 人。每批数据使用 3 种关联方法，共 6 组分析。
scale.en: Two data phases: 313 participants in the internal ADNI1/GO/2 analysis and 313 in external ADNI3. Three association methods per cohort give six analyses.

P1.title: Segmented Linear Mixed Model Analysis Reveals Association of the APOEɛ4 Allele with Faster Rate of Alzheimer's Disease Dementia Progression.

did.zh: 研究随访 211 名从 MCI 进展至阿尔茨海默病痴呆的 ADNI 参与者，比较不同 APOE 基因型的认知及脑体积变化。ε4 携带者在进入痴呆阶段后，全脑、海马、内嗅皮层和颞中回萎缩较快，脑室扩大也较快。
did.en: The study followed 211 ADNI participants who progressed from MCI to Alzheimer's dementia, comparing cognitive and volumetric trajectories by APOE genotype. After dementia onset, ε4 carriers showed faster whole-brain, hippocampal, entorhinal and middle temporal atrophy, along with faster ventricular expansion.

relation.zh: 颞中回萎缩更快的观察使关注点从海马扩展到外侧颞叶。本案例检验的不是萎缩速度，而是一次基线扫描中的体积与 ε4 剂量关系，考察同一遗传线索能否体现在这一结构指标中。
relation.en: The faster middle temporal atrophy finding extends attention beyond the hippocampus to lateral temporal cortex. This case tests volume from a single baseline scan rather than atrophy rate, asking whether ε4 dosage relates to that structural measure.

P2.title: Morphological and Structural Network Analysis of Sporadic Alzheimer's Disease Brains Based on the APOE4 Gene.

did.zh: 研究在 APOE4 背景下比较 AD 与对照的结构 MRI、灰质体积及结构网络，报告 AD 的右颞中回等区域灰质体积降低。
did.en: The study examined structural MRI, grey-matter volume and structural networks in AD and controls in the context of APOE4, reporting reduced right middle-temporal and other regional grey-matter volumes in AD.

relation.zh: 涉及同一颞中回结构和 APOE 研究背景，但摘要中的 AD—对照差异不能被解释成 ε4 剂量对归一化体积的独立效应。
relation.en: It concerns the same middle-temporal structure and APOE context, but the abstract's AD–control contrast cannot be interpreted as an independent ε4-dosage effect on normalized volume.

P3.title: APOE4-related differences in cortical thickness are modulated by sex in middle age.

did.zh: 128名认知正常中年人的研究考察性别、APOE 与皮层厚度。女性的左颞中皮层较厚，APOE 相关差异主要报告于部分额叶及扣带区域，并受性别影响。
did.en: In 128 cognitively unimpaired middle-aged adults, sex and APOE were examined against cortical thickness. Women had thicker left middle-temporal cortex; reported APOE-related differences mainly involved frontal and cingulate regions and varied by sex.

relation.zh: 作为性别与测量选择的相关背景；颞中皮层的性别差异不是 APOE 效应，厚度也不等于本例体积，不据此声称支持剂量假设。
relation.en: This is context for sex and measurement choice. A middle-temporal sex difference is not an APOE effect, and thickness is not this case's volume measure; it does not establish the dosage hypothesis.

P4.title: Selective brain gray matter atrophy associated with APOE ε4 and MAPT H1 in subjects with mild cognitive impairment.

did.zh: 65名遗忘型 MCI 参与者的基线 VBM 研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在海马及颞上、颞中回等区域有更多灰质萎缩，并考察 MAPT 的共同作用。
did.en: Baseline VBM in 65 participants with amnestic MCI found greater grey-matter atrophy in APOE ε4 carriers in hippocampal, superior-temporal and middle-temporal regions, and examined joint effects with MAPT.

relation.zh: 直接涉及 APOE 和颞中回灰质结构，但携带状态、VBM 萎缩模式与本例连续剂量—归一化体积并非同一统计量。
relation.en: It directly concerns APOE and middle-temporal grey matter, but carrier status and VBM atrophy patterns are not identical to continuous dosage against normalized regional volume.

P5.title: Apolipoprotein E polymorphism and brain morphology in mild cognitive impairment.

did.zh: 83名 MCI 参与者按 ε4 的0、1、2拷贝分组进行 VBM 比较；纯合子内侧颞叶灰质密度降低，右颞上及颞中回的改变则报告于白质。
did.en: VBM compared 83 participants with MCI across 0, 1 and 2 ε4 copies. Homozygotes showed reduced medial-temporal grey-matter density; right superior- and middle-temporal changes were reported in white matter.

relation.zh: 提供剂量分组和颞叶形态背景，但颞中回结果属于白质，不能直接当作本例颞中回皮层体积降低的证据。
relation.en: It provides dosage-group and temporal-morphology context, but the middle-temporal result concerns white matter, not direct evidence for lower middle-temporal cortical volume in this case.

next_research.zh: 本例内部分析未显示 APOE ε4 与颞中回体积有明确关联，这一结果也被保留在下一轮输入中。下一轮再次提出了相同的 APOE ε4—颞中回关系；系统识别出它与已经测试的测量组合重复，因此没有重复开展实验。同轮还提出了通路多基因风险与脑室、内嗅皮层体积的候选关系，作为不同于当前组合的新研究问题。
next_research.en: The internal analysis did not show a clear APOE ε4–middle temporal association, and this result was retained in the next round's input. The next round proposed the same relationship again; the system recognized the measurement pair as already tested and did not repeat the experiment. That round also proposed pathway polygenic-risk associations with ventricular and entorhinal volumes as research questions distinct from the current pair.

source.zh: APOE ε4 等位基因剂量越高，基线经颅内容积归一化的颞中回体积越小。
source.en: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline middle temporal volume normalized to intracranial volume.

feedback.zh: 内部主分析的关联接近零（r = −0.034）。这条未获明确支持的结果，与 APOE ε4—海马及 APOE ε4—内嗅皮层结果一起进入下一轮。
feedback.en: The primary internal association was close to zero (r = −0.034). This result without clear support entered the next round together with the APOE ε4–hippocampal and APOE ε4–entorhinal results.

next.zh: 在阿尔茨海默病谱系参与者中，APOE ε4 剂量越高，基线颞中回体积越小。
next.en: Among participants on the Alzheimer's disease spectrum, higher APOE ε4 dosage is associated with smaller baseline middle temporal volume.

next.zh: 同轮还提出：孟德尔型 AD 通路风险越高，脑室体积越大；GABA／谷氨酸通路风险越高，内嗅皮层体积越小。
next.en: The same round also proposed higher Mendelian AD pathway risk with larger ventricular volume, and higher GABA/glutamate pathway risk with smaller entorhinal volume.

change.zh: 第一条提议只改变表述，没有改变 APOE ε4—颞中回这一测量组合；另外两条才更换了遗传因素和影像对象。
change.en: The first proposal changed the wording but not the APOE ε4–middle temporal measurement pair. The other two proposals changed both the genetic factor and the imaging target.

outcome.zh: 重复的 APOE ε4—颞中回提议被识别为已测试项目，没有重复实验；两条通路候选也未继续实验。
outcome.en: The repeated APOE ε4–middle temporal proposal was recognized as already tested and was not rerun. Neither pathway candidate proceeded to an experiment.

significance.zh: 同样被诊断为 MCI 的人，后续进展时间可能不同。若较大的内嗅皮层体积对应较低进展风险，研究者便可比较它在 2、3、5 年窗口中的信息，研究记忆相关结构与疾病进程的关系。临床研究可据此设计不同随访密度的分层方案，并考察哪些人更适合纳入较短观察期的干预研究。
significance.en: People with the same MCI diagnosis may progress over different timescales. If larger entorhinal volume relates to lower progression risk, researchers could compare its information over two-, three- and five-year windows to study how memory-related structure relates to disease course. Clinical studies could use this to investigate follow-up schedules and participant selection for interventions with shorter observation periods.

rationale.zh: 已有随访研究发现，基线内嗅皮层体积与轻度认知障碍（MCI）的后续进展有关（P1）。系统据此提出，把入组时的 MRI 与后来是否、何时出现痴呆联系起来，检验较大体积是否对应较低进展风险。
rationale.en: A previous follow-up study related baseline entorhinal volume to subsequent progression of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) (P1). The system proposed linking MRI at enrollment to whether and when dementia developed, testing whether larger volume corresponds to lower progression risk.

methods.zh: 使用 MCI 参与者的基线内嗅皮层 MRI 体积和后续痴呆发生时间，在 ADNI1/GO/2 与 ADNI3 分别开展 Cox 生存分析。体积按颅内容积归一化，模型考虑年龄、性别、教育及 APOE ε4。分别查看 2 年、3 年、5 年窗口，并报告每个窗口的进展人数、风险比及校正后的统计结果。
methods.en: Baseline entorhinal MRI volume and time to dementia in participants with MCI were analyzed using Cox models in ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3. Volume was normalized to intracranial volume, with adjustment for age, sex, education and APOE ε4. Separate two-, three- and five-year windows report progression events, hazard ratios and multiplicity-adjusted results.

results.zh: 5 年窗口内，内部 140 人中 26 人、外部 98 人中 18 人进展至痴呆。内嗅皮层体积每增加一个标准差，内部风险比为 0.558（95% CI 0.366–0.849，q = 0.0211），外部为 0.617（0.366–1.040，q = 0.1048）。六组分析均为较大体积对应较低风险，但只有内部 5 年结果通过原统计标准。
results.en: Within five years, 26 of 140 internal participants and 18 of 98 external participants progressed to dementia. Per standard-deviation increase in entorhinal volume, the internal hazard ratio was 0.558 (95% CI 0.366–0.849, q = 0.0211), versus 0.617 externally (0.366–1.040, q = 0.1048). All six analyses pointed toward lower risk with larger volume, but only the internal five-year result met the original statistical criterion.

P1.zh: MCI 的 MRI 随访研究：基线海马和内嗅皮层体积有助于预测后续进展。
P1.en: An MRI follow-up study of MCI found that baseline hippocampal and entorhinal volumes helped predict subsequent progression.

P2.zh: 与内嗅皮层基线体积和进展风险直接相关；随访范围、临床样本及协变量组合与本例不完全相同，也未证明队列独立性。
P2.en: It directly concerns baseline entorhinal volume and progression risk, but follow-up, clinical sampling and covariates differ from this case; cohort independence is not established.

P3.zh: 相关于内嗅皮层结构和 MCI 预后，但采用视觉萎缩量表而非归一化连续体积；小样本结果不等于本例风险模型已验证。
P3.en: It relates entorhinal structure to MCI prognosis, but uses a visual atrophy scale rather than normalized continuous volume. This small-sample result does not validate the present risk model.

P4.zh: 与本例基线内嗅皮层体积及进展问题直接相关，但样本小、侧化定义与建模方式不同，不能把原研究准确率迁移成本例表现。
P4.en: It directly addresses baseline entorhinal volume and progression, but its small sample, lateralization and model differ. Its reported accuracy cannot be transferred to this case.

P5.en: It shows that location within the region may affect prognostic value. Local surface deformation is not whole-region entorhinal volume, and separate papers do not automatically imply independent cohorts.

scale.zh: 2 个 MCI 数据批次：内部 ADNI1/GO/2 为 140 人，外部 ADNI3 为 98 人。分别检验 2、3、5 年随访窗口，共 6 组生存分析。

P1.title: MRI of hippocampus and entorhinal cortex in mild cognitive impairment: a follow-up study.

did.zh: 研究随访 60 名 MCI 参与者，平均随访 34 个月，13 人进展至痴呆，其中 9 人为阿尔茨海默病。基线右侧海马及内嗅皮层体积有助于预测痴呆进展，内嗅皮层体积还与阿尔茨海默病转归相关。
did.en: Sixty participants with MCI were followed for an average of 34 months; 13 developed dementia, including nine with Alzheimer's disease. Baseline right hippocampal and entorhinal volumes predicted dementia progression, and entorhinal volume also predicted conversion to Alzheimer's disease.

relation.zh: 该研究已经提示，基线内嗅皮层体积可提供 MCI 预后信息。本案例在 ADNI 的两个批次中重新检验这种关系，并比较 2、3、5 年窗口，观察关联在不同随访长度下是否一致。
relation.en: The study establishes a rationale for baseline entorhinal volume as a prognostic measure. This case re-examines the relationship in two ADNI phases and compares two-, three- and five-year windows to assess consistency over follow-up.

P2.title: Hippocampal and entorhinal atrophy in mild cognitive impairment: prediction of Alzheimer disease.

did.zh: 139名 MCI 患者及63名对照平均随访5年。较小的基线海马和内嗅皮层体积均预测向 AD 转化，但在年龄与认知指标之外增加的预测价值较小。
did.en: Over approximately five years, 139 patients with MCI and 63 controls were followed. Smaller baseline hippocampal and entorhinal volumes predicted AD conversion, with modest added value beyond age and cognition.

relation.zh: 与内嗅皮层基线体积和进展风险直接相关；随访范围、临床样本及协变量组合与本例不完全相同，也未证明队列独立性。
relation.en: It directly concerns baseline entorhinal volume and progression risk, but follow-up, clinical sampling and covariates differ from this case; cohort independence is not established.

P3.title: Specificity of Entorhinal Atrophy MRI Scale in Predicting Alzheimer's Disease Conversion.
P3.journal: The Canadian journal of neurological sciences. Le journal canadien des sciences neurologiques

did.zh: 61名遗忘型 MCI 患者的研究比较内嗅皮层萎缩视觉评分 ERICA 与内侧颞叶萎缩评分预测 AD 转化的表现；ERICA 特异度较高但敏感度较低。
did.en: In 61 patients with amnestic MCI, visual ERICA and medial-temporal atrophy scores were compared for predicting AD conversion. ERICA had higher specificity but lower sensitivity.

relation.zh: 相关于内嗅皮层结构和 MCI 预后，但采用视觉萎缩量表而非归一化连续体积；小样本结果不等于本例风险模型已验证。
relation.en: It relates entorhinal structure to MCI prognosis, but uses a visual atrophy scale rather than normalized continuous volume. This small-sample result does not validate the present risk model.

P4.title: MRI-derived entorhinal volume is a good predictor of conversion from MCI to AD.

did.zh: 27名 MCI 患者接受基线高分辨率 MRI 并随访36个月，10人转化为 AD；基线内嗅皮层和海马体积均有预测价值，其中右内嗅皮层区分表现较好。
did.en: Twenty-seven patients with MCI underwent baseline high-resolution MRI and 36-month follow-up; ten converted to AD. Entorhinal and hippocampal volumes predicted conversion, with right entorhinal volume performing best.

relation.zh: 与本例基线内嗅皮层体积及进展问题直接相关，但样本小、侧化定义与建模方式不同，不能把原研究准确率迁移成本例表现。
relation.en: It directly addresses baseline entorhinal volume and progression, but its small sample, lateralization and model differ. Its reported accuracy cannot be transferred to this case.

P5.title: MRI hippocampal and entorhinal cortex mapping in predicting conversion to Alzheimer's disease.

did.zh: MCI 纵向研究用表面形态学定位进展者的海马与内嗅皮层局部萎缩，提示海马 CA1/下托及双侧内嗅皮层前下极的形变可预测转化。
did.en: A longitudinal MCI study used surface morphometry to localize atrophy associated with conversion, identifying hippocampal CA1/subiculum and bilateral anterior-inferior entorhinal deformation.

relation.zh: 说明同一脑区内部位置可能影响预后价值；局部表面形变不是本例整个内嗅皮层平均体积，相关论文也不自动代表独立队列。
relation.en: It shows that location within the region may affect prognostic value. Local surface deformation is not whole-region entorhinal volume, and separate papers do not automatically imply independent cohorts.

next_research.zh: 系统将本例 2、3、5 年随访的内部结果一并提供给下一轮，使后续研究能够看到内嗅皮层体积与进展风险在不同时间窗口中的关系。下一轮再次提出内嗅皮层—痴呆进展问题，但改为由数据估计关联方向；由于测量组合已经测试，这一提议被识别为重复项。同时，该轮还提出了脑室体积与进展风险的候选关系，但没有开展新的实验。
next_research.en: The system supplied this case's internal results for the 2-, 3- and 5-year follow-up windows to the next round, making the time-window-specific entorhinal–progression associations available for further research. The next round revisited the entorhinal question with the direction to be estimated from data; because the measurement pair had already been tested, it was identified as a duplicate. The same round also proposed a ventricular-volume association with progression risk, but no new experiment followed.

source.zh: 轻度认知障碍（MCI）患者的基线内嗅皮层体积越小，随后进展为痴呆的风险越高。
source.en: Smaller baseline entorhinal volume in people with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) is associated with a higher subsequent risk of progression to dementia.

feedback.zh: 2、3、5 年内部分析均为“体积越大、风险越低”的方向，5 年窗口中关联更清晰（每增加一个标准差，风险比 HR = 0.558）。这些分时间窗口的结果与海马、颞中回结果一起进入下一轮。
feedback.en: The 2-, 3- and 5-year internal analyses all indicated lower risk with larger volume, with a clearer association in the 5-year window (hazard ratio per standard-deviation increase, HR = 0.558). These time-window-specific results entered the next round alongside the hippocampal and middle temporal results.

next.zh: 基线内嗅皮层体积是否与 2、3、5 年内 MCI 进展为痴呆相关？不预先指定正负方向，由数据估计。
next.en: Is baseline entorhinal volume associated with MCI-to-dementia progression within 2, 3 and 5 years, with the direction estimated from data rather than specified in advance?

next.zh: 基线脑室体积是否与同一随访范围内的 MCI 至痴呆进展相关？方向同样由数据估计。
next.en: Is baseline ventricular volume associated with MCI-to-dementia progression within the same follow-up windows, also with the direction estimated from data?

change.zh: 第一条保留内嗅皮层和临床结局，但不再预设降低体积对应更高风险；第二条把影像指标换成脑室体积，临床结局仍为 MCI 至痴呆的进展。
change.en: The first retains the entorhinal measure and clinical outcome but no longer prespecifies higher risk with smaller volume. The second changes the imaging measure to ventricular volume while retaining MCI-to-dementia progression as the outcome.

outcome.zh: 内嗅皮层提议因测量组合已经测试而被去重；脑室候选可映射到数据，但未被选入新实验。
outcome.en: The entorhinal proposal was deduplicated because its measurement pair had already been tested. The ventricular candidate could be mapped to the data but was not selected for a new experiment.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 从已整理的 ADNI 遗传与访视表出发，按受试者合并最早访视，转换数值字段，并用颅内容积归一化脑区体积；ADNI1/GO/2 与 ADNI3 分别用于内部和外部分析。这是表格级处理，使用既有影像测量，不是重新处理原始 MRI。 在基线 MCI 人群中根据后续访视构造进展事件与随访时间，并在各分析窗口截尾；排除无有效随访时间或缺少本例体积测量的记录，对协变量填补并标准化。
text.en: NeuroRuntime starts from prepared ADNI genetics and visit tables, joins each participant's earliest visit, converts numeric fields and normalizes regional volumes by intracranial volume. ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3 supply internal and external analyses respectively. This is table-level processing of existing imaging measurements, not a new raw-MRI preprocessing run. Subsequent visits define progression events and follow-up time for baseline MCI participants, censored at each analysis horizon. Records without valid follow-up time or the case's volume measurement are excluded; covariates are imputed and standardized.

text.zh: 按预后任务配置调整 Cox 模型，分别运行 2、3、5 年窗口，调整年龄、性别、教育和 APOE ε4 剂量。这是预定窗口的同类模型检验，不是用外部结果挑选算法。
text.en: The prognosis task configures adjusted Cox models for the registered 2-, 3- and 5-year horizons, adjusting for age, sex, education and APOE epsilon-4 dosage. These are tests of the same model family across prespecified horizons, not algorithm selection using external results.

text.zh: 逐配置记录包含假设与配置 ID、seed、内部/外部阶段、开始与结束时间、完成状态、主结果、交叉验证结果、警告及失败字段；configuration_ledger 汇集配置执行记录，final_readout 汇总结果。本例的三个配置在内部及外部均记录为 complete。
text.en: Per-configuration records contain hypothesis and configuration IDs, seed, internal/external phase, start and finish times, completion status, primary and cross-validation results, warnings and failure fields. The configuration_ledger collects execution records and final_readout summarizes results. All three configurations for this case are recorded as complete in both internal and external analyses.

text.zh: 报告各窗口的样本量、事件数、每标准差体积对应的 HR、95% 置信区间及 FDR q 值；执行记录还保留内部五折检查和 499 次 bootstrap 配置。结果分析同时核对方向、校正结果和事件数，不将模型完成或单项显著等同于全部支持条件通过。
text.en: Each horizon reports sample size, event count, HR per standard-deviation volume, 95% confidence interval and FDR q value; execution records also retain internal five-fold checks and the 499-bootstrap configuration. Analysis considers direction, multiplicity correction and event counts, rather than equating model completion or one significant statistic with passing all support criteria.

methods.text: HR 表示预测变量每增加一个标准差的风险比，并报告 95% 置信区间。P 为双侧检验值，q 为同任务、同 seed 全部配置的 FDR 校正值。

significance.zh: 如果较大的颞中回体积与较低痴呆风险相一致，病程研究就获得了海马之外的一个候选结构指标。下一步可将其与内侧颞叶测量、命名和语义理解表现共同分析，考察外侧颞叶是否提供额外信息。临床上的潜在用途是让 MCI 随访同时关注记忆与语言功能，探索更完整的进展风险评估。
significance.en: If larger middle temporal volume is associated with lower dementia risk, disease-course research gains a candidate structural measure beyond the hippocampus. Joint analyses with medial temporal measurements, naming and semantic-comprehension performance could test whether lateral temporal structure adds information. A potential clinical use is MCI follow-up that considers language as well as memory, supporting research on more comprehensive progression-risk assessment.

rationale.zh: 既有纵向 MRI 研究把颞中回萎缩与 MCI 进展联系起来（P1）。系统进一步询问，一次基线 MRI 中的颞中回大小，是否已经包含了后续病程的信息。
rationale.en: Earlier longitudinal MRI research linked middle temporal atrophy to MCI progression (P1). The system asked whether middle temporal size in a single baseline MRI already contains information about subsequent disease course.

methods.zh: 把 MCI 参与者的基线颞中回体积与之后是否、何时出现痴呆相联系，分别在 ADNI1/GO/2 与 ADNI3 中使用 Cox 生存模型。体积按颅内容积归一化，模型调整年龄、性别、教育及 APOE ε4。比较 2 年、3 年和 5 年随访窗口，并进行多重检验校正。
methods.en: Baseline middle temporal volume was related to whether and when participants with MCI developed dementia, using Cox models separately in ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3. Volume was normalized to intracranial volume; models adjusted for age, sex, education and APOE ε4. Two-, three- and five-year windows were compared with multiple-testing adjustment.

results.zh: 5 年内，内部 140 人中有 26 例进展，外部 98 人中有 18 例。较大颞中回体积对应较低风险：内部 HR = 0.395（95% CI 0.240–0.650，q = 0.0023），外部 HR = 0.521（0.283–0.962，q = 0.0834）。内部 3 年、5 年分析得到支持；外部 5 年未通过校正，2 年窗口虽 q = 0.0343，但仅有 7 例进展，未达到原完整支持条件。
results.en: Within five years, there were 26 progression events among 140 internal participants and 18 among 98 external participants. Larger middle temporal volume related to lower risk: internal HR = 0.395 (95% CI 0.240–0.650, q = 0.0023); external HR = 0.521 (0.283–0.962, q = 0.0834). Internal three- and five-year analyses were supported. The external five-year analysis did not pass correction; the two-year analysis had q = 0.0343 but only seven events and did not meet the original full support criteria.

P1.zh: 纵向 MRI 研究：海马、颞中回及全脑萎缩和脑室扩大，与 MCI 进展至阿尔茨海默病的风险有关。
P1.en: A longitudinal MRI study related hippocampal, middle temporal and whole-brain atrophy, and ventricular enlargement, to the risk of progression from MCI to Alzheimer's disease.

P2.zh: 直接涉及颞中回和进展时间，但使用纵向变化信息，而本例检验基线体积；同属 ADNI，不能自动视为独立验证。
P2.en: It directly concerns middle-temporal structure and time to progression, but incorporates longitudinal change rather than baseline volume alone. Shared ADNI provenance prevents assuming independent validation.

P3.zh: 提供颞中回结构的预后背景，但厚度不是体积，组合积分也不是单一脑区的风险效应；ADNI 样本可能重叠。
P3.en: It provides prognostic context for middle-temporal structure, but thickness is not volume and a composite score is not a single-region risk effect. ADNI samples may overlap.

P4.zh: 与颞中回和临床进展相关，但主要证据是随访萎缩速度，不是较低基线体积的独立风险比。
P4.en: It relates middle-temporal structure to progression, but the relevant finding is longitudinal atrophy, not an independent hazard ratio for lower baseline volume.

P5.zh: 涉及同一颞中结构和两年预后，但测量为厚度而非体积，也不能将重复使用 ADNI 视为独立队列复现。
P5.en: It concerns the same middle-temporal structure and two-year prognosis, but measures thickness rather than volume. Reuse of ADNI is not independent cohort replication.

scale.zh: 2 个 MCI 数据批次：内部 ADNI1/GO/2 为 140 人，外部 ADNI3 为 98 人。分别检验 2、3、5 年随访窗口，共 6 组生存分析。
scale.en: Two MCI data phases: 140 internal ADNI1/GO/2 participants and 98 external ADNI3 participants. Two-, three- and five-year windows give six survival analyses.

P1.title: A longitudinal analysis of T1-weighted MRI features associated with progression from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease.

did.zh: 研究对 947 名 ADNI MCI 参与者的 192 项 MRI 结构指标进行纵向分析，随访中 314 人进展至阿尔茨海默病。分析筛出包括右颞中回、海马、脑室及全脑体积在内的结构特征，其变化轨迹与进展风险相关。
did.en: The study analyzed 192 longitudinal MRI structural measures in 947 ADNI participants with MCI, of whom 314 progressed to Alzheimer's disease. Selected features included right middle temporal, hippocampal, ventricular and whole-brain measures whose trajectories related to progression risk.

relation.zh: 这项研究把右颞中回的纵向萎缩轨迹与进展风险联系起来。本案例转而检验一次基线 MRI 中的颞中回体积是否已经包含预后信息，并在另一 ADNI 批次及不同随访窗口中比较。
relation.en: The study links longitudinal right middle temporal atrophy to progression risk. This case asks whether volume from one baseline MRI already contains prognostic information and compares another ADNI phase and different follow-up windows.

P2.title: Prediction of Conversion to Alzheimer's Disease with Longitudinal Measures and Time-To-Event Data.

did.zh: ADNI-1 研究联合纵向指标和生存资料预测 MCI 向 AD 转化；颞中回与海马体积属于较强影像预测指标，但认知指标通常更强。
did.en: An ADNI-1 study jointly modelled longitudinal measures and survival to predict MCI-to-AD conversion. Middle-temporal and hippocampal volumes were strong imaging predictors, although cognitive measures were generally stronger.

relation.zh: 直接涉及颞中回和进展时间，但使用纵向变化信息，而本例检验基线体积；同属 ADNI，不能自动视为独立验证。
relation.en: It directly concerns middle-temporal structure and time to progression, but incorporates longitudinal change rather than baseline volume alone. Shared ADNI provenance prevents assuming independent validation.

P3.title: A point-based tool to predict conversion from mild cognitive impairment to probable Alzheimer's disease.
P3.journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association

did.zh: ADNI 研究构建 MCI 向 AD 转化的积分工具，组合日常功能、颞中皮层变薄、海马体积及认知测验来预测3年转化。
did.en: An ADNI study developed a point score for MCI-to-AD conversion combining daily function, middle-temporal cortical thinning, hippocampal volume and cognitive tests to predict three-year conversion.

relation.zh: 提供颞中回结构的预后背景，但厚度不是体积，组合积分也不是单一脑区的风险效应；ADNI 样本可能重叠。
relation.en: It provides prognostic context for middle-temporal structure, but thickness is not volume and a composite score is not a single-region risk effect. ADNI samples may overlap.

P4.title: Using voxel-based morphometry to map the structural changes associated with rapid conversion in MCI: a longitudinal MRI study.

did.zh: 18名遗忘型 MCI 患者随访18个月，7人转化为 AD；转化者在海马、颞下/颞中回等区域表现出更快的灰质丢失。
did.en: Eighteen patients with amnestic MCI were followed for 18 months; seven converted to AD. Converters showed faster grey-matter loss in hippocampal, inferior-/middle-temporal and other regions.

relation.zh: 与颞中回和临床进展相关，但主要证据是随访萎缩速度，不是较低基线体积的独立风险比。
relation.en: It relates middle-temporal structure to progression, but the relevant finding is longitudinal atrophy, not an independent hazard ratio for lower baseline volume.

P5.title: Utility of combinations of biomarkers, cognitive markers, and risk factors to predict conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer disease in patients in the Alzheimer's disease neuroimaging initiative.

did.zh: ADNI 研究比较两年内116名转化者与204名未转化者，多类指标联合分析中，基线延迟记忆和颞中叶皮层厚度能预测转化；认知指标通常比多数生物标志物更稳健。
did.en: An ADNI study compared 116 converters and 204 non-converters over two years. Baseline delayed memory and middle-temporal cortical thickness predicted conversion in combined models; cognition was generally more robust than most biomarkers.

relation.zh: 涉及同一颞中结构和两年预后，但测量为厚度而非体积，也不能将重复使用 ADNI 视为独立队列复现。
relation.en: It concerns the same middle-temporal structure and two-year prognosis, but measures thickness rather than volume. Reuse of ADNI is not independent cohort replication.

next_research.zh: 颞中回体积与进展风险的内部结果，连同海马和内嗅皮层的分析一起传入下一轮，其中保留了不同随访窗口的效应和不确定性。下一轮除重新讨论已有脑区外，还提出脑室体积是否与轻度认知障碍进展为痴呆相关，将候选范围从脑组织体积拓展到脑室这一不同的结构指标。这个新增候选尚未进入实验检验。
next_research.en: The internal middle temporal–progression results entered the next round alongside the hippocampal and entorhinal analyses, retaining the effects and uncertainty for each follow-up window. In addition to revisiting existing regions, the next round asked whether ventricular volume was associated with progression from mild cognitive impairment to dementia, extending the candidate set from brain tissue volumes to a different structural measure. The new candidate did not proceed to experimental testing.

source.zh: MCI 患者的基线颞中回体积越小，随后进展为痴呆的风险越高。
source.en: Smaller baseline middle temporal volume in people with MCI is associated with a higher subsequent risk of progression to dementia.

feedback.zh: 内部分析中，较大的颞中回体积对应较低进展风险，5 年风险比为每增加一个标准差 HR = 0.395。系统把 2、3、5 年的结果，与同轮海马和内嗅皮层结果一起传入下一轮。
feedback.en: The internal analyses associated larger middle temporal volume with lower progression risk, with a 5-year hazard ratio per standard-deviation increase of HR = 0.395. The system supplied the 2-, 3- and 5-year results to the next round together with hippocampal and entorhinal results from the same round.

next.zh: 基线经颅内容积归一化的脑室体积，是否与 MCI 患者随后进展为痴呆的风险相关？在预定随访窗口中检验，关联方向由数据估计。
next.en: Is baseline ventricular volume normalized to intracranial volume associated with subsequent dementia progression in people with MCI, tested within the prespecified follow-up windows with direction estimated from data?

change.zh: 从局部脑组织的颞中回体积换到脑室体积；研究人群和痴呆进展结局不变，但后轮没有预设“大体积对应高风险还是低风险”。
change.en: The imaging measure changes from regional middle temporal tissue volume to ventricular volume. The MCI population and dementia-progression outcome remain the same, but the later proposal does not prespecify whether larger volume implies higher or lower risk.

outcome.zh: 脑室体积这一后轮候选可映射到数据，但未被选入后续实验。
outcome.en: The later ventricular-volume candidate could be mapped to the data but was not selected for a subsequent experiment.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 从已整理的 ADNI 遗传与访视表出发，按受试者合并最早访视，转换数值字段，并用颅内容积归一化脑区体积；ADNI1/GO/2 与 ADNI3 分别用于内部和外部分析。这是表格级处理，使用既有影像测量，不是重新处理原始 MRI。 在基线 MCI 人群中根据后续访视构造进展事件与随访时间，并在各分析窗口截尾；排除无有效随访时间或缺少本例体积测量的记录，对协变量填补并标准化。
text.en: NeuroRuntime starts from prepared ADNI genetics and visit tables, joins each participant's earliest visit, converts numeric fields and normalizes regional volumes by intracranial volume. ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3 supply internal and external analyses respectively. This is table-level processing of existing imaging measurements, not a new raw-MRI preprocessing run. Subsequent visits define progression events and follow-up time for baseline MCI participants, censored at each analysis horizon. Records without valid follow-up time or the case's volume measurement are excluded; covariates are imputed and standardized.

text.zh: 按预后任务配置调整 Cox 模型，分别运行 2、3、5 年窗口，调整年龄、性别、教育和 APOE ε4 剂量。这是预定窗口的同类模型检验，不是用外部结果挑选算法。
text.en: The prognosis task configures adjusted Cox models for the registered 2-, 3- and 5-year horizons, adjusting for age, sex, education and APOE epsilon-4 dosage. These are tests of the same model family across prespecified horizons, not algorithm selection using external results.

text.zh: 逐配置记录包含假设与配置 ID、seed、内部/外部阶段、开始与结束时间、完成状态、主结果、交叉验证结果、警告及失败字段；configuration_ledger 汇集配置执行记录，final_readout 汇总结果。本例的三个配置在内部及外部均记录为 complete。
text.en: Per-configuration records contain hypothesis and configuration IDs, seed, internal/external phase, start and finish times, completion status, primary and cross-validation results, warnings and failure fields. The configuration_ledger collects execution records and final_readout summarizes results. All three configurations for this case are recorded as complete in both internal and external analyses.

text.zh: 报告各窗口的样本量、事件数、每标准差体积对应的 HR、95% 置信区间及 FDR q 值；执行记录还保留内部五折检查和 499 次 bootstrap 配置。结果分析同时核对方向、校正结果和事件数，不将模型完成或单项显著等同于全部支持条件通过。
text.en: Each horizon reports sample size, event count, HR per standard-deviation volume, 95% confidence interval and FDR q value; execution records also retain internal five-fold checks and the 499-bootstrap configuration. Analysis considers direction, multiplicity correction and event counts, rather than equating model completion or one significant statistic with passing all support criteria.

pre.title: 全脑体积与MCI 至痴呆的进展
pre.hypothesis: Higher baseline WholeBrain_icv is hypothesized to be associated with lower subsequent risk of mci_to_dementia.
pre.hypothesis_plain: 在轻度认知障碍（MCI）人群中，较大的基线全脑体积预计与较低的后续痴呆风险相关。
pre.definition: 预测变量为基线 WholeBrain_icv；结局为从 MCI 进展至痴呆的时间。影像体积均以颅内容积归一化。
pre.rationale: 既有研究将全脑体积纳入 MCI 进展的预测模型。系统据此检验基线全脑体积与不同随访时间窗内痴呆风险的关系。

methods.title: 数据集
methods.text: 内部分析使用 ADNI1/GO/2 的 MCI 参与者，外部分析使用 ADNI3 的 MCI 参与者；样本量及进展事件数见结果表。

methods.title: 测量与统计模型
methods.text: 使用 Cox 比例风险模型，调整年龄、性别、教育和 APOE ε4 剂量；分别分析 2 年、3 年与 5 年随访窗口。

methods.title: 结果指标
methods.text: HR 表示预测变量每增加一个标准差的风险比，并报告 95% 置信区间。P 为双侧检验值，q 为同任务、同 seed 全部配置的 FDR 校正值。

significance.zh: 全脑体积提供的是整体结构信息，而非某一个记忆脑区。若较大体积对应较低进展风险，可进一步比较整体与局部指标在不同随访窗口中的表现，研究哪类结构信息更贴近近期或较长期的病程。临床研究可借此优化短期复查与长期观察的分层设计，并帮助确定干预研究需要多长的随访。
significance.en: Whole-brain volume captures overall structure rather than one memory-related region. If larger volume relates to lower progression risk, researchers could compare global and regional measures across follow-up windows to investigate which are more informative about nearer- or longer-term course. Clinical studies could use this to refine short- and long-term follow-up strata and investigate appropriate observation periods for interventions.

rationale.zh: 既有研究将全脑体积与海马、脑室及认知指标一起用于预测 MCI 进展（P1）。系统据此单独检验全脑体积这一整体结构指标，询问其与短期及较长期痴呆风险的关系。
rationale.en: Earlier research used whole-brain volume alongside hippocampal, ventricular and cognitive measures to predict MCI progression (P1). The system tested whole-brain volume as a global structural measure, examining its relationship to nearer- and longer-term dementia risk.

methods.zh: 研究基线全脑 MRI 体积与 MCI 后续进展至痴呆的时间关系，在 ADNI1/GO/2 和 ADNI3 中分别使用 Cox 模型。全脑体积按颅内容积归一化，并调整年龄、性别、教育及 APOE ε4。使用 2 年、3 年、5 年三个随访窗口，比较整体脑结构与近期、较长期风险的关联。
methods.en: Baseline whole-brain MRI volume was related to time from MCI to dementia using Cox models separately in ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3. Whole-brain volume was normalized to intracranial volume, adjusting for age, sex, education and APOE ε4. Two-, three- and five-year windows compared associations of global brain structure with nearer- and longer-term risk.

results.zh: 5 年内，内部 158 人中 29 人、外部 101 人中 18 人进展至痴呆。两队列都支持较大全脑体积与较低风险相关：内部 HR = 0.555（95% CI 0.361–0.854，q = 0.0211），外部 HR = 0.425（0.221–0.817，q = 0.0185）。外部 3 年结果也得到支持；其余较短窗口未在两队列一致通过原条件。
results.en: Within five years, 29 of 158 internal participants and 18 of 101 external participants progressed to dementia. Both cohorts supported lower risk with larger whole-brain volume: internal HR = 0.555 (95% CI 0.361–0.854, q = 0.0211); external HR = 0.425 (0.221–0.817, q = 0.0185). The external three-year result was also supported; other shorter-window results did not consistently meet the original criteria in both cohorts.

P1.zh: MCI 随访研究：联合脑体积、遗传、淀粉样蛋白及认知指标预测进展，并比较不同随访长度下的表现。
P1.en: An MCI follow-up study combined brain-volume, genetic, amyloid and cognitive measures to predict progression and compared performance across follow-up durations.

P2.zh: 提供脑储备与进展的相关背景，但海马/全脑比值不能解释为全脑体积本身的保护效应，且随访窗口更短。
P2.en: It provides brain-reserve and progression context, but a hippocampal/whole-brain ratio cannot be interpreted as a protective effect of whole-brain volume itself; follow-up is also shorter.

P3.zh: 这是全脑体积—转化假设的重要零结果及结局区分，不能因为与连续评分相关就写成支持痴呆转化风险。
P3.en: This is an important null result and endpoint distinction for the whole-brain-volume conversion hypothesis. An association with continuous decline must not be recast as support for dementia conversion.

P4.zh: 与归一化全脑体积和 MCI 进展密切相关，同时提示疾病阶段重要；脑实质比例、成像序列与本例 WholeBrain_icv 的实现仍需区分。
P4.en: It is closely related to normalized whole-brain volume and MCI progression and emphasizes disease stage. Brain parenchymal fraction and its imaging implementation still differ from this case's WholeBrain_icv.

P5.zh: 提供全脑与局部指标的直接比较及边界结果；全脑萎缩率不等于基线体积，合并样本的关联不能替代 MCI 子组结论。
P5.en: It directly compares global and regional measures and supplies a limiting result. Whole-brain atrophy rate is not baseline volume, and pooled-sample associations cannot replace MCI-specific conclusions.

scale.zh: 2 个 MCI 数据批次：内部 ADNI1/GO/2 为 158 人，外部 ADNI3 为 101 人。分别检验 2、3、5 年随访窗口，共 6 组生存分析。
scale.en: Two MCI data phases: 158 internal ADNI1/GO/2 participants and 101 external ADNI3 participants. Two-, three- and five-year windows give six survival analyses.

P1.title: Variation in Variables that Predict Progression from MCI to AD Dementia over Duration of Follow-up.
P1.journal: American journal of Alzheimer's disease (Columbia, Mo.)

did.zh: 研究随访 139 名 ADNI MCI 参与者，将全脑、海马、脑室体积与遗传、脑脊液及认知指标联合用于预测进展。模型在不同随访时间的预测表现有所变化，认知指标在较晚随访阶段仍有预测价值。
did.en: The study followed 139 ADNI participants with MCI and combined whole-brain, hippocampal and ventricular volumes with genetic, CSF and cognitive measures to predict progression. Predictive performance varied with follow-up duration, while cognitive measures remained informative later in follow-up.

relation.zh: 既有模型已纳入全脑体积，但它与其他脑区、认知和生物标志物共同参与预测。本案例单独考察这一整体结构指标与进展时间的关联，并将观察窗口延伸到 5 年。
relation.en: The earlier model included whole-brain volume together with regional, cognitive and biological measures. This case examines the global structural measure's association with time to progression and extends the observation window to five years.

P2.title: Cognitive and brain reserve in conversion and reversion in patients with mild cognitive impairment over 12 months of follow-up.
P2.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental neuropsychology

did.zh: 123名 MCI 患者随访12个月，研究认知与脑储备对转化或恢复的关系；恢复者的基线海马/全脑体积比更高，部分区域灰质丢失组间无显著差异。
did.en: In 123 patients with MCI followed for 12 months, cognitive and brain reserve were studied against conversion or reversion. Reverters had a higher baseline hippocampal/whole-brain volume ratio, while some regional grey-matter-loss comparisons were non-significant.

relation.zh: 提供脑储备与进展的相关背景，但海马/全脑比值不能解释为全脑体积本身的保护效应，且随访窗口更短。
relation.en: It provides brain-reserve and progression context, but a hippocampal/whole-brain ratio cannot be interpreted as a protective effect of whole-brain volume itself; follow-up is also shorter.

P3.title: Clinically feasible automated MRI volumetry of the brain as a prognostic marker in subjective and mild cognitive impairment.

did.zh: 156名主观认知下降或 MCI 患者的自动 MRI 体积研究发现，全脑体积未关联诊断转化，但与 CDR-SB 年变化有关；诊断转化和连续认知恶化呈不同结果。
did.en: Automated MRI volumetry in 156 patients with subjective decline or MCI found that whole-brain volume was not associated with diagnostic conversion, but was associated with annual CDR-SB change. Diagnostic conversion and continuous decline yielded different results.

relation.zh: 这是全脑体积—转化假设的重要零结果及结局区分，不能因为与连续评分相关就写成支持痴呆转化风险。
relation.en: This is an important null result and endpoint distinction for the whole-brain-volume conversion hypothesis. An association with continuous decline must not be recast as support for dementia conversion.

P4.title: Magnetic resonance imaging white matter hyperintensities and brain volume in the prediction of mild cognitive impairment and dementia.

did.zh: 前瞻性队列以脑实质占颅腔比例衡量全脑结构；该比例较低可预测基线 MCI 者向痴呆转化，但不预测正常认知者向 MCI 进展。
did.en: A prospective cohort measured global structure as brain parenchymal fraction. Lower fraction predicted dementia conversion in baseline MCI, but not progression from normal cognition to MCI.

relation.zh: 与归一化全脑体积和 MCI 进展密切相关，同时提示疾病阶段重要；脑实质比例、成像序列与本例 WholeBrain_icv 的实现仍需区分。
relation.en: It is closely related to normalized whole-brain volume and MCI progression and emphasizes disease stage. Brain parenchymal fraction and its imaging implementation still differ from this case's WholeBrain_icv.

P5.title: Hippocampal atrophy rates in Alzheimer disease: added value over whole brain volume measures.

did.zh: 研究比较海马与全脑 MRI 指标预测 AD 进展的价值；全脑萎缩率在合并无痴呆样本中有预测作用，但在 MCI 子组中仅海马基线体积和萎缩率预测进展。
did.en: A study compared hippocampal and whole-brain MRI predictors of AD progression. Whole-brain atrophy rate predicted progression in the pooled non-demented sample, but only hippocampal baseline volume and atrophy rate predicted progression within MCI.

relation.zh: 提供全脑与局部指标的直接比较及边界结果；全脑萎缩率不等于基线体积，合并样本的关联不能替代 MCI 子组结论。
relation.en: It directly compares global and regional measures and supplies a limiting result. Whole-brain atrophy rate is not baseline volume, and pooled-sample associations cannot replace MCI-specific conclusions.

next_research.zh: 全脑体积与进展风险的内部分析结果，与海马、颞中回的结果一起成为下一轮的输入。后续提议转向局部结构，分别询问内嗅皮层和颞中回体积是否与轻度认知障碍进展为痴呆相关。这两条提议没有通过实验执行前的检查，因此这条研究链在提出后续问题后结束，未产生新的实验结果。
next_research.en: The internal whole-brain volume–progression results became input to the next round together with the hippocampal and middle temporal results. Subsequent proposals focused on regional structures, asking separately whether entorhinal and middle temporal volumes were associated with progression from mild cognitive impairment to dementia. Neither proposal passed the pre-execution checks, so this research sequence ended after formulating the follow-up questions without producing new experimental results.

source.zh: MCI 患者的基线全脑体积越大，随后进展为痴呆的风险越低。
source.en: Larger baseline whole-brain volume in people with MCI is associated with a lower subsequent risk of progression to dementia.

feedback.zh: 内部分析的三个随访窗口均为体积越大、风险越低，5 年风险比为每增加一个标准差 HR = 0.555。全脑体积结果与同轮的海马、颞中回结果一起进入下一轮。
feedback.en: All three internal follow-up windows indicated lower risk with larger volume, with a 5-year hazard ratio per standard-deviation increase of HR = 0.555. The whole-brain results entered the next round alongside hippocampal and middle temporal results from the same round.

next.zh: 基线内嗅皮层体积是否与 MCI 进展为痴呆相关？
next.en: Is baseline entorhinal volume associated with progression from MCI to dementia?

next.zh: 基线颞中回体积是否与 MCI 进展为痴呆相关？
next.en: Is baseline middle temporal volume associated with progression from MCI to dementia?

change.zh: 从全脑总体积转向内嗅皮层、颞中回两个局部结构；患者人群和进展结局不变。后轮两条原始提议只提出“有关联”，没有指定增大或减小的方向。
change.en: The focus moves from total whole-brain volume to two regional structures, the entorhinal cortex and middle temporal gyrus, retaining the population and progression outcome. Both original later proposals ask about an association without specifying its direction.

outcome.zh: 两条提议均未通过实验执行前检查，没有产生新的实验结果。
outcome.en: Neither proposal passed the pre-execution checks, so neither produced a new experimental result.

text.zh: NeuroRuntime 从已整理的 ADNI 遗传与访视表出发，按受试者合并最早访视，转换数值字段，并用颅内容积归一化脑区体积；ADNI1/GO/2 与 ADNI3 分别用于内部和外部分析。这是表格级处理，使用既有影像测量，不是重新处理原始 MRI。 在基线 MCI 人群中根据后续访视构造进展事件与随访时间，并在各分析窗口截尾；排除无有效随访时间或缺少本例体积测量的记录，对协变量填补并标准化。
text.en: NeuroRuntime starts from prepared ADNI genetics and visit tables, joins each participant's earliest visit, converts numeric fields and normalizes regional volumes by intracranial volume. ADNI1/GO/2 and ADNI3 supply internal and external analyses respectively. This is table-level processing of existing imaging measurements, not a new raw-MRI preprocessing run. Subsequent visits define progression events and follow-up time for baseline MCI participants, censored at each analysis horizon. Records without valid follow-up time or the case's volume measurement are excluded; covariates are imputed and standardized.

text.zh: 按预后任务配置调整 Cox 模型，分别运行 2、3、5 年窗口，调整年龄、性别、教育和 APOE ε4 剂量。这是预定窗口的同类模型检验，不是用外部结果挑选算法。
text.en: The prognosis task configures adjusted Cox models for the registered 2-, 3- and 5-year horizons, adjusting for age, sex, education and APOE epsilon-4 dosage. These are tests of the same model family across prespecified horizons, not algorithm selection using external results.

text.zh: 逐配置记录包含假设与配置 ID、seed、内部/外部阶段、开始与结束时间、完成状态、主结果、交叉验证结果、警告及失败字段；configuration_ledger 汇集配置执行记录，final_readout 汇总结果。本例的三个配置在内部及外部均记录为 complete。
text.en: Per-configuration records contain hypothesis and configuration IDs, seed, internal/external phase, start and finish times, completion status, primary and cross-validation results, warnings and failure fields. The configuration_ledger collects execution records and final_readout summarizes results. All three configurations for this case are recorded as complete in both internal and external analyses.

text.zh: 报告各窗口的样本量、事件数、每标准差体积对应的 HR、95% 置信区间及 FDR q 值；执行记录还保留内部五折检查和 499 次 bootstrap 配置。结果分析同时核对方向、校正结果和事件数，不将模型完成或单项显著等同于全部支持条件通过。
text.en: Each horizon reports sample size, event count, HR per standard-deviation volume, 95% confidence interval and FDR q value; execution records also retain internal five-fold checks and the 499-bootstrap configuration. Analysis considers direction, multiplicity correction and event counts, rather than equating model completion or one significant statistic with passing all support criteria.

scoring.case_composite: Arithmetic mean of all five numeric ratings; otherwise null. Evidence and available prior feedback are assessed together.
scoring.session_composite: Mean of complete applicable-item case composites; report dimension counts and case coverage separately.
scoring.study_composite: Equal-weight mean of case-level mean composites; withhold the full-panel mean unless every case has a valid composite.
scoring.interpretation: Descriptive expert-rated research-capability index (1–5) with complete research outputs available during all ratings. Not an outcome-blind hypothesis evaluation, validated latent scale, discovery probability, or scientific ground truth. Do not pool with the two-stage protocol. Do not pool with earlier six-item or experimental-rigor ratings; historical answers are not recoded.
